jobs.title: Associate Linux Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Associate Linux Support Engineer

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Associate Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. This role is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer with eagerness to learn, a passion for Linux and open source technologies to work with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex cloud environments, desktop and server issues, Linux kernel crashes we’ve never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and customers. You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full technical stack at Canonical, across cloud, desktop and IoT. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. This is a globally remote role.

Location: This is a globally remote role.

The role entails

  • Working from your remote home office to provide technical support for employees.
  • Being available to take ownership of new cases via telephone, email and web
  • Acting as an internal customer advocate keeping them updated in a timely manner
  • Ensuring that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
  • Contributing new knowledge base articles and maintaining existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
  • Drafting and distributing technical notices for internal and external communication.
  • Prioritising your work in order to accomplish the most important and urgent tasks first
  • Keeping on learning as our products and services grow and evolve
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix
  • Maintaining regular communication and information exchange with the rest of the team, locally and remotely
  • Identifying and suggesting any opportunities to provide a better service
  • Participating in a regular weekend working rotation

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path. Preferable majors: Computer Science, MIS, Electrical Engineering, etc.
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files)
  • Knowledge or basic hands-on experience on 2 or more of:
    • Linux server administration
    • Programming fundamentals in any language (bash, Perl, Ruby, Javascript, C or C++, Go)
    • Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.) 
    • Virtualization / Cloud computing concepts (provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.)
  • Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Noting that we require and will perform a background check for this role.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience supporting virtualized environments (KVM, Virtual Box, VMWare)
  • Experience with other open-source desktop technologies
  • Active contribution to open-source projects/forum/code

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Secure Container Images
jobs.description:
Software Engineer - Secure Container Images

With more than 10 billion pulls, Canonical's container images are trusted by developers worldwide to build and run software securely and at scale. That trust rests on our commitment to hardened, production-ready images.

We are advancing the state of the art with a new generation of Ubuntu-based container images we call "rocks": minimal images engineered for performance and usability and backed by long-term security commitments. As a member of the team, you will own the path from upstream source to published image, turning open source software into tested, signed, and continuously maintained artifacts that developers can deploy with confidence.

This is fast-paced, multi-disciplinary software engineering. Because most of the software we package originates from third-party upstreams, you will work across a broad range of container technologies and hundreds of open source projects, often in several programming languages, integrating and maintaining them so they are easy to consume on Ubuntu. Automation is central to the role: you will build the pipelines that package, build, test, and publish images at scale.

Your seniority in this role will reflect your software engineering experience and your ability to mentor and guide more junior colleagues.

Location: This role is based in the EMEA region

This role entails

  • Build and maintain a growing portfolio of high-quality, hardened container images
  • Design and operate automated CI/CD pipelines that build, test, scan, sign, publish, promote, and retire images across environments and architectures
  • Write tooling and tests to assess security compliance and cloud-native compatibility
  • Work closely with the community and partners to share container expertise and keep our portfolio current with new features, patches, and applications
  • Collaborate with our product security, platform, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams
  • Contribute technical input to the team's decision-making
  • Set the standard for quality, defining image standards that span security, compatibility, performance, size, and developer experience
  • Grow our knowledge base and write about the work we do
  • Work in a collaborative, agile, and globally distributed environment
  • Mentor colleagues and contribute to hiring
  • Work from home with global travel of up to 15% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Proficiency in Bash and Python
  • Experience working with CI/CD systems (e.g. GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
  • Experience building container images
  • Command of at least one container management or orchestration tool (e.g. Docker, Podman, or Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with Linux systems, package management, build systems, release engineering, or artifact pipelines
  • Clear communication and end-to-end ownership, spanning design, review, documentation, operation, and cross-team collaboration
  • A commitment to sharing knowledge and helping those around you grow
  • A genuine appetite for learning and for working outside your comfort zone
  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, a STEM field, or a similar discipline
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Business level written and spoken English.
  • Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.
  • International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
  • 0-7 years relevant experience.

In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:

  • Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.
  • Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.
  • Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.
  • Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

Nice-to-have skills

  • A security-oriented maintenance mindset: you can investigate dependency and vulnerability findings, assess their impact, and deliver a safe fix
  • An understanding of software supply chain security, with some experience generating and consuming artifacts such as SBOMs, signatures, provenance, or CVE reports
  • Familiarity with GitOps principles and workflows
  • Familiarity with additional languages such as Go or Rust
  • Hands-on experience building minimal and distroless container images
  • Knowledge of the OCI specifications
  • Familiarity with security or compliance frameworks such as CIS, NIST, FedRAMP, or DISA STIG
  • Evidence of contributions to open source projects
  • A passion for embedding security across all stages of the engineering lifecycle (DevSecOps), and an interest in using AI or agentic development responsibly and safely
  • Relevant Linux, container, or cloud-native certifications (such as CKS or DCA) are welcome

If your experience is close but does not match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We value transferable experience from Linux packaging, release engineering, build systems, platform engineering, and open-source maintenance.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Bi-annual compensation review
  • Company recognition rewards
  • 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Graduate Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Graduate Customer Success Manager

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical

Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer’s objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.

This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.

Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.

What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team

What we are looking for in you

  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Business Development Manager

Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5, 000 specialists.

We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems.

The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe.

Ajax Systems production includes four factories, two of which are located in Ukraine, one in Turkey and one in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission.

Key requirements:

  • Proven track record of being involved in the entire sales process, from identifying new business opportunities, developing proposals and presentations, negotiating, and closing deals.

Dutch Sports Localization Specialist (Football)
As a trusted global transformation partner, Welocalize accelerates the global business journey by enabling brands and companies to reach, engage, and grow international audiences. Welocalize delivers multilingual content transformation services in translation, localization, and adaptation for over 250 languages with a growing network of over 400,000 in-country linguistic resources. Driving innovation in language services, Welocalize delivers high-quality training data transformation solutions for NLP-enabled machine learning by blending technology and human intelligence to collect, annotate, and evaluate all content types. Our team works across locations in North America, Europe, and Asia serving our global clients in the markets that matter to them. www.welocalize.com
 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
OVERVIEW
 
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB
 
Welocalize is seeking passionate and culturally fluent Sports Subject Matter Experts specialized in football with exceptional writing skills to join our localization team. You’ll review, localize, fact check, translate, and adapt football-related content so it resonates with audiences in your market. 
 
Project Details:
Language Pair: English (US) > Dutch (Netherlands)
Task Type: Quality Control, Translation, Copy Edit, MTPE
Assessment: Grammar + SME knowledge

MAIN DUTIES

  • Review, localize, fact check, translate, and adapt sports-related content, mainly football, while adhering to writing style guides and guidelines
  • Conduct market-specific research on local content, product and terminology trends, and best localization practices for the target audience in your market
  • Provide feedback on written content

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • BS/BA and/or 2+ years of work experience in the linguistic field, sports journalism, copywriting, or in copy-editing
  • Extensive sports knowledge, mainly football
  • Experience in translation and localization of multimedia content, preferably also machine translations and evaluations
  • Native-level fluency in the target language
  • Excellent grammar and writing skills in the native language
  • Strong creative writing, proofreading, and editing skills in the native language
  • Tech savvy: strong practical knowledge of computers and mobile devices, word processors, and spreadsheets
  • Owning licensed version of MS Office apps
  • Ability to work independently and remotely

BONUS IF YOU HAVE:

  • Published work on platforms like ESPN, The Athletic, FourFourTwo, or similar.
  • Experience working with sports media platforms, live score apps, or sports streaming services.
  • A flair for adapting voice and style to Gen Z, football fan culture, and pop culture audiences.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist

Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in railway and industrial electrification systems, offering cutting-edge solutions to enhance transportation and decarbonize industrial processes. With a rich heritage of over a century and a commitment to innovation, Sécheron Hasler Group is growing worldwide.

For the Electrical Safety Solutions (ESS) Business Unit, we are looking for an experienced marketing professional with a strong interest in technical products and industrial markets. The Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist will translate ESS business priorities and product value propositions into clear marketing communications, sales tools, product training and customer-facing materials. The candidate will work closely with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers, Sales and the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.

Global objectives:

  • Drive the execution of the ESS marketing plan and business growth priorities, in cooperation with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers and Sales.
  • Develop and maintain marketing and sales materials for existing and new products and applications.
  • Develop product marketing communication using various communication channels to promote ESS and its respective products.
  • Work with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team for trade shows/fairs and manage the required preparation and coordination with the respective Business Unit teams.
  • Provide marketing inputs and product communication materials to support Product Line Managers and Sales.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver marketing communication plans based on ESS business priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager.
  • Contribute to product launch plans defined with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers; coordinate the preparation and delivery of marketing materials, training and communication activities
  • Develop marketing and sales materials, including commercial brochures, PowerPoint presentations, promotional videos and animations for products and applications, and website content.
  • Collect and structure market and competitor information; prepare customer-oriented product messages, competitive comparisons and sales enablement materials in collaboration with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers.

jobs.title: Sales & Customer Support Specialist EMEA (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sales & Customer Support Specialist EMEA (m/w/d)

IMPORTANT: Please be aware, scammers may try to impersonate Zello by reaching out regarding job opportunities. We will never ask you for bank account information, checks, or other sensitive information as part of our hiring process. All correspondence will come from the zello.com email domain. If you’re unsure, please email ----- with questions.

About Zello

Zello is a voice-first communication platform, powered by our industry-leading push-to-talk technology, to improve collaboration and productivity for desk-less workers. With over 175+ million users, we’re the #1 rated push-to-talk app in the world, delivering 9 billion (yes, with a B) messages a month. 

At Zello, our company values are at the heart of what we do everyday. We’re proud to serve the frontline, we’re privileged to connect people in times of crisis across the globe, and we’re honored to support first responders.

And this is where you come in.

Zello keeps frontline teams connected with instant push-to-talk voice. Our customer base across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific is growing faster than separate sales and support queues can keep up with. This role owns the inbound experience for those customers end to end, from the first pricing question to the first support ticket, so new customers buy faster and stay longer. You'll be based in Munich, report to our Sales Leader EMEA, and work closely with our Account Executives, Support, and Customer Success teams.

After a successful first year, you will

  • Have owned inbound EMEA and APAC leads end to end, responding to every new inquiry within one business day and converting at least 20% of qualified leads into paying customers.

  • Have closed a steady monthly run-rate of new SMB deals and plan upgrades, with every opportunity tracked accurately in HubSpot.

  • Have resolved at least 80% of support tickets on first contact, with customer satisfaction at or above team target.

  • Have built a library of macros, setup guides, and FAQ answers that measurably reduced repeat tickets on the most common topics.

  • Have handed off at least 10 qualified expansion opportunities to Account Executives, becoming a reliable source of enterprise pipeline.

What you'll do

  • Respond to inbound inquiries, demo requests, and trial sign-ups from across EMEA and APAC, qualify them, and close SMB deals and plan upgrades.

  • Run demos and onboarding calls in English, showing frontline teams how Zello fits the way they already work.

  • Work the support queue in HubSpot: troubleshoot account, channel, and device issues across Android, iOS, rugged handsets, and PTT accessories.

  • Escalate what you can't solve to Tier 2 and Engineering with clean reproduction steps, and close the loop with the customer.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate, with every contact, deal, and ticket logged and a clear next step.

  • Spot customers outgrowing self-serve and hand them to Account Executives with the context they need to win.

  • Turn recurring questions into help content and macros, and feed customer feedback back to Product.

Who you are

  • You've spent 2+ years in a role that combined selling and supporting customers, such as inside sales, SaaS support, or customer success, and can point to deals you closed and customers you kept.

  • You speak and write fluent English. Another language is a plus.

  • You're based in Munich, or ready to be.

  • You troubleshoot hands-on: you're comfortable setting up Android and iOS devices, two-way radios or rugged handsets, and working through Wi-Fi, LTE, or Bluetooth issues until it works.

  • You've worked in HubSpot or a comparable CRM and ticketing tool, and you keep your records clean without being chased.

  • You explain technical things in plain language to people who aren't technical, like a warehouse supervisor or a dispatcher mid-shift.

  • You follow through: when you tell a customer you'll get back to them, you do, and they remember it.

  • You raise problems early and share what you learn, so the next ticket or deal goes faster for the whole team.

This Role Is Not

  • A pure support role measured only on ticket volume. Sales outcomes are half the job.

  • An enterprise Account Executive role. Large, multi-stakeholder deals go to the AE team.

  • A Tier 3 engineering role. You diagnose and escalate; you don't fix code.

  • A people management role.

We hire for potential, passion for our mission, and a knack for solving difficult problems over checking every qualification box. We have competitive pay, equity with significant upside, and intentionally design our benefits to encourage healthy and well-balanced employees, flexible schedules and time off. We even offer a sabbatical after every five years of service so you’re able to pursue and enjoy what matters most to you. And of course, we wouldn’t be a technology company without a ping-pong table and free snacks in our break room. Join us!

Zello provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

All Zello personnel are required to comply with defined security, privacy, and compliance requirements applicable to their role along with requirements that are applicable to all Zello personnel.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Business Partner - 12 months FTC
Mid-market Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Mid-market Customer Success Manager

UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services.  We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

🤝 The team

You will join our Global MidMarket Customer Success team, a group of Customer Success Managers who each own a broad, evolving portfolio of mid-market accounts. While the function operates globally, this specific opening is dedicated to the EMEA & APAC regions

Based in Paris, you will work closely with 2 Mid-Market CSMs (1 in London, 1 in NYC) and 1 Scale Ops Manager (Paris). Matthieu, Head of Scale CSM and your manager, based in Paris, will support you in achieving your goals. You will also be part of a global Customer Success community across our international offices.

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide:

  • Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts

  • Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment

  • Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth. Split between Enterprise CSMs, who build deep, tailored relationships with a small number of strategic accounts, and Mid-Market CSMs, who manage a larger book of accounts with a focus on speed and ROI, acting where and when it counts

  • Support Engineers: Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience

🖋️ Your responsibilities

As a Mid-Market Customer Success Manager, you will own a broad portfolio of Mid-Market accounts end-to-end. Working at pace and using usage data and account signals to prioritize your day, you will make sure your accounts renew, stay healthy, and grow, spotting upsell/expand opportunities as proactively as you spot churn risk, and owning both through to close.

This is a role for someone energized by volume and by building repeatable, data-driven ways of working across a large book of business, without losing the client-first mindset that drives portfolio growth.

Portfolio Ownership & Signal-Driven Execution (60%)

Own the business performance and KPIs of a large portfolio of Mid-Market accounts, and take individual accountability for contributing to team and company targets:

  • Own your portfolio's KPIs (usage, renewal rate, NRR, churn) end to end with a hunter/rescuer mindset: moving fast to capture opportunity, and stepping in decisively when an account is at risk

  • Structure your coverage around two core touchpoints, kickoff and renewal, complemented by additional touchpoints where and when the data calls for it

  • Continuously monitor usage data, health scores, and other signals to prioritize your day and catch risk or opportunity early

  • React quickly and decisively on negative signals to protect the account, and on positive signals to capture upsell potential

  • Judge, account by account, how much time and effort a situation deserves, and adjust your touchpoint cadence accordingly - guided increasingly by shared scoring and playbooks as the Scale motion matures

Product & Industry Expertise (20%)

Build broad product and industry expertise to support adoption at scale, rather than deep knowledge of any single client:

  • Develop a strong understanding of UpSlide's product and of the industries your portfolio operates in

  • Contribute to adoption initiatives such as webinars and open office hours, sharing your expertise across the client base

Scale Motion Optimization (10%)

Bring a critical eye to how the Mid-Market motion runs, and help make it faster and more effective:

  • Share structured feedback on where automation and process changes can save time

  • Suggest and help build content that increases client engagement and adoption

  • Work closely with the Scale Ops Manager and the Head of Scale to turn feedback into concrete improvements

Cross-functional Collaboration (10%)

Stay connected to the teams around your portfolio, notably those handling first-line requests:

  • Sync regularly with Support and Sales Admin, who own level 1 requests and escalate to you when needed

  • Partner with Sales on expansion opportunities that require broader support

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Microsoft Office, UpSlide, Salesforce, Gong, PowerBI, Notion (or local equivalents).

⚡ Your goals

What you'll be assessed on:

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

  • Churn

  • Upsell / Expansion contribution

  • CRM data quality and forecast accuracy


You are a great fit if you have:

  • 2/3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing/revenue role in a B2B environment

  • Proven experience managing renewals and churn across a portfolio of accounts, with the confidence to handle difficult conversations (renegotiation, dissatisfaction) as needed

  • Proven ability to identify and close expansion/upsell opportunities, with a hunter mindset and a strong ROI orientation

  • Experience autonomously managing a sizeable portfolio, ideally including Mid-Market accounts

  • A structured, analytical approach to account planning at volume, using data to prioritize a broad book of business and anticipate risk

  • Operational rigor: accurate CRM data, reliable follow-up, dependable forecasting

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in French and English

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, international environment

We’d love it if you have:

  • Experience with analytics / BI tools (PowerBI or equivalent)

  • Advanced negotiation skills

  • Knowledge of the financial services / professional services sector

  • Familiarity with SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, forecasting) and reporting to leadership

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Screening call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role.

  2. Interview with your future manager or their peer: A deeper dive into your Customer Success experience and approach to account management.

  3. Case study + team-meet: A live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team.

  4. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: A policy adapted to each team’s rhythm

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

  • An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day)

✅ General:

  • Meal vouchers (Tickets resto): €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year)

  • Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle): Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children

  • Commute (Transports): Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨

jobs.title: Directeur de Projet DATA CENTER
jobs.description:
Directeur de Projet DATA CENTER

Direction de Projets – Ingénierie, Construction & Infrastructures Critiques

1. Présentation du poste

Intitulé : Directeur de Projet Data Center (Data Center Project Director)

Rattachement hiérarchique : Directeur des Opérations / Directeur de Programme / Direction Générale

Périmètre : France et International

Secteur : Data Centers – Infrastructures critiques – Construction – Ingénierie

2. Mission principale

Le Directeur de Projet Data Center assure le pilotage stratégique, technique, opérationnel et financier de projets complexes de conception, de construction, d'extension ou de transformation de Data Centers.

Il garantit la bonne exécution des projets dans le respect des engagements contractuels, des budgets, des délais, des exigences de qualité, de sécurité, de performance énergétique et de disponibilité des infrastructures.

Il intervient sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets, depuis les études de faisabilité jusqu'à la réception des installations, leur mise en service et leur transfert aux équipes d'exploitation.

Véritable chef d'orchestre, il coordonne les différentes parties prenantes et assure l'interface entre la maîtrise d'ouvrage, la maîtrise d'œuvre, les bureaux d'études, les entreprises de construction, les fournisseurs et les exploitants.

3. Responsabilités principales

A. Direction et pilotage stratégique des projets

  • Définir la stratégie globale d'exécution et les objectifs du projet.

  • Piloter des projets de Data Centers neufs (Greenfield), d'extension ou de rénovation (Brownfield).

  • Superviser toutes les phases du projet, de la faisabilité à la livraison.

  • Définir les jalons, les livrables et les indicateurs de performance.

  • Mettre en place la gouvernance et les instances de décision.

  • Arbitrer les choix techniques, économiques et organisationnels.

  • Anticiper les risques et définir les plans d'atténuation.

  • Assurer le reporting auprès de la Direction Générale, des investisseurs et des clients.

B. Management technique et coordination des études

Superviser et coordonner l'ensemble des disciplines techniques :

Électricité – Courants forts et faibles

  • Réseaux HTB/HTA/BT et postes de transformation.

  • Tableaux électriques, TGBT et distribution électrique.

  • Groupes électrogènes et systèmes d'alimentation secourue.

  • Onduleurs (UPS), batteries et systèmes de distribution.

  • Architectures de redondance N+1, 2N et autres configurations adaptées aux exigences de disponibilité.

  • Coordination des protections électriques, sélectivité et continuité de service.

CVC – Refroidissement et traitement d'air

  • Production et distribution frigorifique.

  • Groupes froids, free cooling et refroidissement adiabatique.

  • CRAH, CRAC et Fan Walls.

  • Systèmes de refroidissement liquide (Liquid Cooling).

  • CDU et solutions de Direct-to-Chip Cooling.

  • Optimisation des performances thermiques et énergétiques.

Bâtiment et infrastructures

  • Génie civil, structure et architecture.

  • VRD et raccordements aux réseaux.

  • Sécurité incendie et systèmes de détection/extinction.

  • Contrôle d'accès, vidéosurveillance et sûreté physique.

  • BMS, DCIM, GTB et supervision technique.

  • Intégration des infrastructures IT et télécoms.

Assurer la cohérence technique des études, la gestion des interfaces et la conformité aux exigences contractuelles et réglementaires.

C. Pilotage des études et de la conception

  • Superviser les études de faisabilité et les avant-projets.

  • Piloter les phases de conception selon les référentiels contractuels applicables, notamment RIBA 0 à 4 pour les projets concernés.

  • Valider les choix architecturaux et techniques.

  • Organiser les revues de conception et les analyses de risques.

  • Superviser la coordination BIM et les études de synthèse.

  • Garantir la constructibilité, la maintenabilité et l'exploitabilité des installations.

  • Piloter les démarches de Value Engineering.

  • Optimiser le CAPEX sans compromettre les exigences de performance et de résilience.

D. Direction de la construction et de l'exécution

  • Définir la stratégie de réalisation et le phasage des travaux.

  • Superviser les entreprises générales, les lots techniques et les sous-traitants.

  • Coordonner les équipes de maîtrise d'œuvre et de construction.

  • Garantir le respect des plannings et des jalons contractuels.

  • Piloter les interfaces entre génie civil, électricité, CVC et infrastructures IT.

  • Superviser les procédures de contrôle qualité.

  • Veiller au respect des exigences HSE.

  • Gérer les modifications, non-conformités et situations critiques.

  • Organiser les opérations préalables à la réception.

E. Gestion financière et contractuelle

  • Construire et piloter le budget global du projet.

  • Superviser les engagements financiers et le suivi des dépenses.

  • Piloter les CAPEX et les prévisions à terminaison (Estimate at Completion).

  • Identifier les dérives budgétaires et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

  • Superviser les consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

  • Piloter les contrats de maîtrise d'œuvre, d'ingénierie, de construction et de fourniture.

  • Gérer les avenants, réclamations contractuelles et risques financiers.

  • Optimiser les coûts et préserver les marges du projet.

  • Assurer un reporting financier fiable et régulier.

F. Commissioning et mise en service

  • Définir et superviser la stratégie de commissioning.

  • Coordonner les essais des équipements et systèmes techniques.

  • Superviser les essais fonctionnels et les essais intégrés (Integrated Systems Testing).

  • Vérifier les scénarios de fonctionnement normal, dégradé et secouru.

  • Piloter la levée des réserves et la clôture des non-conformités.

  • Garantir la remise des DOE, procédures et documentations techniques.

  • Organiser la formation des équipes d'exploitation.

  • Superviser le transfert opérationnel vers les équipes Facilities Management et Data Center Operations.

G. Management des équipes et des parties prenantes

  • Encadrer les chefs de projet, Design Managers, Construction Managers et responsables techniques.

  • Coordonner les bureaux d'études, consultants et partenaires.

  • Définir les responsabilités et les objectifs des équipes.

  • Animer les réunions de pilotage et les comités de direction.

  • Développer une culture de performance, de sécurité et de collaboration.

  • Gérer les situations conflictuelles et les arbitrages complexes.

PLC Software Engineer - The Netherlands

Ready to build the software behind real-world renewable energy installations?

At Bright Renewables, your PLC software doesn’t stay behind a desk. You’ll see it come to life in complex industrial installations for renewable gas and CO₂ technologies.

As a PLC Software Engineer, you’ll be involved in the complete automation lifecycle - from software design and programming to testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization.

You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions, help shape our automation standards, and work alongside experienced colleagues as part of an international software engineering team of around 10 engineers. Together, you’ll collaborate across the Netherlands, Latvia, and Poland to develop and deliver reliable, innovative automation solutions.


Why this role?

You’ll get the opportunity to:

  • Own your solutions - contribute to software solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from design and programming to testing and commissioning;

  • Work on real installations - solve automation challenges in complex renewable energy plants;

  • Have technical influence - contribute to software standards, templates, concepts, and ways of working, within a team that values collaboration and embraces innovative ideas from everyone;

  • Keep developing - work alongside experienced Electrical and Software Engineers and continue building your technical expertise;

  • Work internationally - collaborate with colleagues and project teams in the Netherlands, Poland, Latvia and beyond, including regular international travel to visit our offices and project sites;

  • Choose what works for you - work 32 or 40 hours per week, with flexible starting times and opportunities to work from home;

  • Make an impact - use your automation expertise in technologies that contribute directly to the energy transition.

What will you do?

As a PLC Software Engineer, you design, develop, test, and commission PLC and SCADA control systems for technologies such as gas upgrading and CO₂ liquefaction.

You report directly to the Manager E&I and Software and work closely with Electrical Engineers, Process Engineers and fellow Software Engineers.

Depending on your experience, you’ll also have the opportunity to take more technical ownership, contribute to software concepts and standards, and support colleagues with complex automation challenges.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Designing, programming, testing, and commissioning PLC and SCADA systems;

  • Developing control software for gas upgrading, CO₂ liquefaction, and other renewable energy technologies;

  • Taking ownership of your software from engineering through commissioning;

  • Testing and troubleshooting software during commissioning and operation;

  • Analyzing and resolving software and control-related issues in existing installations;

  • Implementing software updates and optimizations;

  • Supporting Service Engineers with more complex automation and software questions;

  • Contributing to software standards, templates, and automation concepts;

  • Working closely with Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, and other technical disciplines;

  • Sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues within the engineering team.


What do you bring?

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to take responsibility for their own engineering work.

Ideally, you have:

  • A completed technical education in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field;

  • Several years of experience in PLC/SCADA engineering within an industrial environment;

  • Hands-on experience in PLC programming, ideally with Siemens S7 and TIA Portal, combined with knowledge of WinCC SCADA, industrial communication networks, and remote access solutions.

  • Experience with commissioning and troubleshooting industrial installations;

  • A good understanding of automation architectures and industrial control systems;

  • Good command of English, both spoken and written;

  • Knowledge of OT security is a plus.

What’s in it for you?

We want to give you the technical freedom and working environment to do your best engineering work.

You can expect:

  • A competitive salary based on your experience and technical background;

  • The option to work 32 or 40 hours per week;

  • Flexible starting times between 7:00 and 9:00 a.m. ;

  • Ample opportunities to work from home, including a one-time €250 allowance to set up your home office;

  • An attractive annual profit-sharing scheme for employees with at least 12 months of service;

  • An excellent pension scheme;

  • 8% annual holiday allowance;

  • A commuting allowance of €0.23 per kilometer, in accordance with our employment conditions;

  • A high level of autonomy and responsibility;

  • Plenty of opportunities for technical and professional development;

  • An international engineering environment with both experienced professionals and engineers earlier in their careers;

  • The opportunity to work with renewable energy technologies and contribute directly to the energy transition;

  • A bike lease program and rewards for cycling to work;

  • A modern, sustainably built working environment in Hengelo.

About Bright Renewables

Bright Renewables develops and delivers technologies for renewable gas and CO₂ capture, providing solutions from engineering and realization through to service and maintenance. Our installations convert biogas into renewable natural gas and capture, purify, and liquefy CO₂ for industrial reuse.

We are part of HoSt Group, a family-owned Dutch company operating internationally in renewable energy technology.

For you, that means working on international projects with the opportunities of a global organization, while keeping the short communication lines, technical freedom, and personal approach of a family-owned company.

Contact Wybren Broersma, Manager E&I and Software, or Natalia Wisniewska, Corporate Recruiter, at +31 88 460 90 80.

jobs.title: Testing a Financial App for Italian Business Owners
jobs.description:
Testing a Financial App for Italian Business Owners

Hi there! We are Testlio, a global software testing company with its own freelance network. Our freelancers test apps from companies across the globe. Testlio is a great place for people who value the freedom and flexibility of remote work.

At the moment, we are looking for Business Owners based in Italy to collaborate in testing a popular platform's new user onboarding flow for businesses.

Your testing will help identify and resolve issues for business owners across Italy who wish to create PayPal business accounts. We're specifically looking for individuals who own Limited Companies (Società a Responsabilità Limitata - S.R.L. / S.R.L.S.) in Italy and speak Italian. Your task would be to create a Paypal Business account for your company and record any bugs along the way. You will be acting like a new PayPal user, sharing your honest feedback about the experience. With your help, the PayPal team will be amble to improve the experience of new users!

Note: We cannot collaborate if you have an existing PayPal account tied to your Limited Company. It is OK if you have a personal PayPal account, as this will not disrupt the testing flow. 

To participate in this project, you will need to create an account on our platform. Through this account, we can assign you testing tasks. You will be asked to use our website for defect tracking and will receive materials to prepare you for testing.

Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio

  • Schedule: You can create your schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you.
  • Location: Testlio is a 100% remote company. Seriously, you can work from the coffee shop, your home, or while waiting for class.
  • Growth: You’ll be testing global-scale mobile apps and have the chance to boost your skills and grow your career.
  • Payment: You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. This means you get paid even if you did not uncover any bugs.

Requirements

  • Age: You have to be at least 18 years old.
  • Location: Must be physically located in Italy.
  • Availability: 30 minutes for your Testlio account setup and 2 hours for the actual PayPal testing task, which will be paid.
  • Devices: iOS device (iPhone or iPad), Android device (Android Tablet or Phone), Laptop/Desktop.
  • Experience: Software testing experience is a plus, but if you are new to testing, we offer free courses to help you learn and grow. We offer a preparatory course that will help you learn more about testing on our website.

What does testing look like?

  • Type of testing: Functional testing.
  • Type of work: short-term, freelance.
  • Workload: Regular weekly cadence, with additional ad-hoc requests possible throughout the week
  • Pay rate: The pay rate for this is 30 USD/hr.
  • Payment: You are paid weekly via PayPal or Payoneer.
    • We will pay you through a personal Paypal account, if you chose to go with that option.

jobs.title: Webdesigner (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Webdesigner (w/m/d)

Einleitung

Wir sind auf der Suche nach neuen Kollegen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Prozess der Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht, unserer juristischen Kompetenz und einem starken Team von zahlreichen Mitarbeitern begleiten wir tausende Mandanten erfolgreich auf dem Weg zur deutschen Staatsbürgerschaft. Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich einen Einblick unter migrando(.)de/karriere, unserer Karriere-Page. Denn wir können hier schreiben was wir wollen, im Endeffekt bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang in der Praxis gearbeitet und Hands-on-Erfahrungen gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Wir bieten Dir

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Mix aus gestalterischer Freiheit und echtem Impact. Du arbeitest nicht an abstrakten Konzepten, die irgendwann vielleicht live gehen – sondern an Produkten, die täglich tausende Menschen sehen und nutzen. Dein Output ist sichtbar, messbar und macht einen Unterschied.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Kreativprojekte
    Bei uns gestaltest du echte Produkte: von Landingpages für Rechtsberatung über Infoportale bis zu interaktiven Online-Assistenten.
  • Zugang zu Premium-Tools
    Du arbeitest mit modernen Plugins und Tools wie Figma, Lovable, Bricks und Hubspot.
  • Firmen-Zugänge für Adobe und Co.
    Selbstverständlich erhältst du bei dieser Stelle Zugriff auf die Adobe Creative Cloud und alle anderen Tools, die du brauchst.
  • KI-Design
    Du darfst direkt Hand anlegen, wenn es darum geht, neue KI-Tools für deine Designs auszuprobieren. Vielleicht ergibt sich ein neuer Workflow für dich? Wir ermutigen unsere Mitarbeiter in vielen Bereichen, KI zu nutzen, um die Arbeit schneller und leichter zu machen. Dazu stellen wir dir Claude, ChatGPT und Gemini in der jeweiligen Pro-Version zur Verfügung.
  • Große Inspirations- und Asset-Bibliotheken
    Dir stehen zahlreiche Icons, Illustrationen und hochwertige Design-Assets zur Verfügung. Wir haben außerdem Pro-Zugänge für Tools wie Mobbin, damit du direkt von den großen Playern lernen kannst.
  • High-End Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook Pro M3 oder Dell XPS mit Linux. Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, inkl. 4K-Monitoren.
  • Große Reichweite
    Über die Jahre konnten wir mit unserer Plattform bereits viele Menschen erreichen. Diese große Menge an Traffic ermöglicht es uns, schnell Ergebnisse zu sehen und führt zu einem sinnesstiftenden Arbeitsgefühl.
  • Echte Eigenverantwortung
    Du bist nicht Umsetzer fremder Ideen. Du bringst eigene Perspektiven ein, triffst gestalterische Entscheidungen und hast einen direkten Draht zu allen Teams und der Geschäftsführung – ohne lange Freigabe-Schleifen.
  • Kleine Teams statt Großraumbüro
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt und schnell ins Gespräch kommt.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und keinen anderen stört), kannst du auch gerne Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen in den Räumen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch. Einen Einblick in unsere Räumlichkeiten kannst du dir auf unserer Website anschauen.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit moderner Ausstattung
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, ein leistungsstarker Laptop und eine ruhige Umgebung.
  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Gleichzeitig ist Home Office jederzeit möglich. Auch spontan und ohne lange Abstimmung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit ohne Kernzeiten
    Bei uns gibt es keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster, in denen du anwesend sein musst.
  • Flexible Teilzeitmodelle
    Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell. Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Spontan Urlaub nehmen
    Manchmal braucht man einfach eine Auszeit. Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen.
  • Familienfreundliche Kultur
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend oder kurzfristiger Arzttermin – wir wissen, dass solche Situationen zum Alltag gehören. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Kurze Wege
    Bei uns musst du dich nicht durch die Hierarchien hangeln oder lange Mails schreiben, um gehört zu werden. Du kannst jederzeit direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung sprechen. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Austausch ist direkt und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Mitgestalten statt nur abarbeiten
    Wir suchen Kolleg:innen, die mitdenken. Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie ein Prozess besser laufen kann, ein Tool sinnvoll wäre oder ein Workflow smarter funktionieren könnte, dann wirst du gehört.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Tätigkeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit – es ist Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung und spürbarer Wirkung.
  • Feel-Good-Angebote im Haus
    Unsere Feel-Good-Managerin sorgt regelmäßig für kleine Auszeiten – von Nacken- und Schultermassagen über kurze Entspannungs- und Beauty-Sessions bis hin zu Momenten zum Durchatmen.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events
    Wir feiern gern. Sommerfest am See, gemütliche Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner mit der Abteilung. Unsere Events sorgen dafür, dass wir als Team zusammenwachsen und den Arbeitsalltag auch mal beiseiteschieben können. Aber keine Sorge: Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht und eher Gehen auch kein Problem.
  • Fitnessraum im Haus
    Unser eigener Fitnessraum steht dir direkt im Haus zur Verfügung – kostenlos, gut ausgestattet und jederzeit zugänglich.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Mix aus Design- und Implementationsarbeit. Je nach deinen Stärken und Interessen übernimmst du Aufgaben, die dich als festes Standbein des Design-Teams etablieren oder das Entwickler-Team frontend-seitig unterstützen. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Landingpages entwickeln
    Du baust klare und überzeugende Landingpages – etwa zu Einbürgerung, Aufenthaltstiteln oder neuen Tools – und schaffst Strukturen, die sowohl Nutzer abholen als auch gute Conversions bringen.
  • Visuelle Konzepte entwickeln
    Du entwirfst moderne und gut strukturierte Layouts für Landingpages, Websites und interne Projekte und Tools. In Figma baust du komplette Design-Konzepte und setzt diese ggf. auch um.
  • Infobeiträge entwickeln
    Du gestaltest Blog- und Newsbeiträge und hilfst dabei, Inhalte verständlich aufzubereiten, einzupflegen und live zu schalten.
  • Mobile Optimierung
    Du passt Designs gezielt für mobile Geräte an und bist dir bewusst, dass unsere Website zum größten Teil auf dem Handy genutzt wird.
  • Seiten mit WordPress + Elementor aufbauen
    Du setzt deine Figma-Designs in WordPress um – mit Elementor Pro, Custom HTML/SCSS und Liebe zum Detail. Hier und da wirst du auch mit anderen Tools in Kontakt kommen: Bricks, Hubspot oder bspw. E-Mail-Designer-Tools.
  • Modulare Templates entwickeln
    Du erstellst wiederverwendbare Elementor-Templates, globale Styles und komponentenbasierte Layout-Bausteine, damit unsere Projekte nicht nur schön, sondern auch effizient und konsistent bleiben.
  • Laufende Pflege
    Du machst HTML/CSS-Anpassungen, pflegst Menüs, Custom Post Types und globale Styles und kümmerst dich um Performance-Themen wie Bildoptimierung, Lazy Load oder Caching.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit SEO, Content & Performance
    Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Teams zusammen, um Conversion zu verbessern und Elemente suchmaschinenfreundlich aufzubereiten.
  • Bildbearbeitung & Auswahl
    Du wählst passende Bilder oder erstellt diese selbst. Denk an: Beitragsbilder für Blog- oder Newsbeiträge.
  • A/B-Testing
    Du entwickelst Designvarianten für Tests und stimmst dich mit dem Team ab, um herauszufinden, was bei unseren Nutzer:innen wirklich funktioniert.

Dein Profil

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang Hands-on-Erfahrungen in der Praxis gesammelt, Seiten gebaut, Layouts optimiert und Designs für echte Nutzer:innen umgesetzt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • WordPress & Elementor
    Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit WordPress und Elementor und kennst die typischen Stolpersteine aus eigener Arbeit.
  • Grundlagen im Webdesign-Stack
    HTML5 und CSS3 beherrschst du gut, gern auch mit SASS/LESS.
  • Gespür für Design
    Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie, Abstände und Struktur und gleichzeitig ein Verständnis dafür, wie Nutzer:innen online denken und navigieren.
  • Sicher im Umgang mit Design-Tools
    Du nutzt Figma (oder vergleichbare Tools wie Sketch oder Adobe XD), um Wireframes, Prototypen und finalen UI-Designs umzusetzen. Du arbeitest visuell klar, strukturiert und gerne kollaborativ.
  • Detailverliebt mit Blick fürs Ganze
    Du achtest auf jedes Pixel, auf Abstände und Micro-Details, behältst aber trotzdem die größere User Journey und das strategische Ziel der Seite im Blick.
  • Routine im Responsive Design
    Desktop, Tablet, Mobile – für dich sind das keine Extras, sondern ein selbstverständlicher Teil jedes Projekts. Du kannst Layouts für verschiedene Breakpoints sauber aufeinander abstimmen.
  • Erfahrung im Webdesign
    Du hast bereits mit WordPress, Elementor, Figma oder HTML/CSS gearbeitet und fühlst dich in dieser Welt wohl.
  • Keine formellen Voraussetzungen
    Du musst kein Studium oder 30 Weiterbildungen haben. Wir wollen Talente und fähige neue Kollegen finden. Selbst wenn du nicht alle Punkte hier erfüllst - wir sind auf der Suche nach erfahrenen und verantwortungsbewussten Kollegen, idealerweise bist du schon viele Jahre in dem Bereich aktiv und konntest viele Learnings mitnehmen. Denn genau daran sind wir interessiert: saubere, langfristig robuste Problemlösungen. Und die hat man meist erst, nachdem man es einige Zeit auf die harte Tour lernen musste.
  • Einfache Kommunikation
    Du bist kommunikativ und offen. Eigentlich wollen wir hier keine generischen Sachen schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist wichtig. Gute Zusammenarbeit schlägt oft reines Know-how. Ein Kollege, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos ist, kann im Alltag wertvoller sein als jemand mit mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber eher schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch oder am besten beides (ca. B2-Level). Keine Angst, wir wollen keinen Sprachnachweis sehen.

Internal Communications Lead

Elliptic has been tracking down crypto crime since 2013, trusted by banks, businesses, and governments worldwide to keep the financial system safe. Today, our compliance tools cover the large majority of global crypto exchange volume, and a $120m Series D is fueling the next stage of that work.

jobs.description:
AI Engineer

Who are we?

Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence.

Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses.

Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore.


How we work

  • Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data.

  • Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer.

  • Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted.

What will you do?

The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents.

  • The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead.

  • The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real.

  • Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins.

  • Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view.

  • Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks.

In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models.

Who are you?

  • You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering.

  • In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos.

  • You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data.

  • You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one.

  • You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting.

  • Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed.

The team

You'll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who's been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it.

The stack

  • Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI

  • LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents.

  • Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire

  • Data: PostgreSQL with pgvector

  • Cloud: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions

What do we offer?

  • Competitive base salary and annual bonus linked to your performance / OKRs

  • Attractive benefits including health & wellbeing allowance, work-from-home budget, learning & coaching benefits, etc. 

  • Flexible hybrid working model with 3 days per week in our Amsterdam office 

  • Healthy work-life balance allowing for planability and personal commitments 

  • Chance to grow with the company gaining increasing responsibilities, supported by lots of coaching and a feedback-driven approach 

  • Tremendous learning and career progression opportunities 

  • International environment with hubs in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore

  • Culture of trust, ownership and standard of excellence and a fun working atmosphere with regular outings and events 

  • Post product-market fit and aspiring unicorn status - this is an excellent time to join & grow with us!

Does this sound like a perfect match?

We are proud of our wonderful product and believe it has lots of potential. We are growing fast and having fun while building our platform and company. Does this sound like a team you would like to become a part of? Click ‘Apply’ and submit your CV, we are excited to get to know you and show you what we do!

Customer Success Manager (f/m/d)

At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Join our Customer Success team, where you will focus on driving SaaS revenue growth through proactive customer engagement. While leveraging data insights, you will proactively identify upsell opportunities and mitigate churn risks. Your strategic guidance and deep product knowledge will be essential in helping customers unlock new value of our product and set them up for success.

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

  • Drive customer engagement - through building and nurturing value-creating and scalable relationships, you develop a deep understanding of your clients’ and their finance goals. You guide and consult with them in order to drive their engagement and the activation of all the spend management features.

  • Upsell - you leverage your deep understanding of both the product and your customer's needs to identify new business opportunities, as well as product and feature optimisation initiatives to increase value for existing accounts. 

  • Measure success and provide data insights - with the use of specific KPIs you aim to achieve and monitor revenue trajectory through, for example, key metrics such as spend engagement, SaaS uplift and renewals.

  • Act as Product ambassador - working closely with internal stakeholders, you compile and communicate client feedback and act in an advisory capacity on current and future product features. 

  • Thrive for process excellence - you aim for continuous improvement, designing and delivering upon the client journey touchpoints that will increase customer satisfaction and contribute towards long-term retention.

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role:

  • Proven experience in a proactive commercial-centric role, ideally in a B2B setting.

  • Prior experience with upselling products and product features to existing clients.

  • Fluent in English (C2)..

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Customer obsessed - You empathize with the needs and pain points of the customer and provide a flawless experience.

  • Commercially minded - You are able to demonstrate continuous value to customers, leveraging new business opportunities and can confidently negotiate pricing, contracts and add-ons.

  • Clear communicator - You are able to communicate complex topics to a range of audiences in a clear, concise and expert manner.

  • Analytical mindset - You are able to read, interpret and leverage data to prioritize customers, solve complex problems, identify upsell opportunities and retain customer happiness. You can recognise problems before they arise, and you challenge the status quo.

  • Expert Operator - You are able to manage multiple requests at the same time and prioritize accordingly. You have a structured way of working, employing efficiency and effectiveness in your day-to-day tasks.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.
