Enterprise Customer Success Manager

UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services. We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

🤝 The team

You will join our Enterprise Customer Success team for the EMEA, APAC, and NA regions, a group of Customer Success Managers, each responsible for a focused portfolio of our largest and most strategic accounts.

You will join a team of 6, including 5 CSMs and Majhon, Head of Customer Success Enterprise, who will support you in achieving your goals. You will also be part of a global Customer Success community across our five offices.

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide:

  • Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts

  • Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment

  • Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth

  • Support Engineers: Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience

🖋️ Your responsibilities

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own the end-to-end relationship with a portfolio of our largest, most strategic accounts. You will build deep, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders, lead high-impact business reviews, and act as a trusted advisor, proactively protecting and growing revenue across your book through both retention and expansion.

This is a role for someone who thrives on depth: fewer accounts, higher stakes, and the ability to build genuine, senior-level relationships that compound into long-term growth, while knowing how to sync with regional counterparts on accounts that span multiple geographies, keeping a global view of the relationship without owning every part of it directly.

Account Ownership & Revenue Growth (50%)

Own the business performance, strategy, and health of your portfolio of strategic accounts:

  • Take full ownership of your portfolio (ARR, NRR, renewal, risk level)

  • Build and execute structured, tailored account plans for 100% of your accounts, with clear growth and retention objectives

  • Proactively identify both expansion opportunities and churn risk through data analysis and direct relationship insight, and own them through to resolution or close

  • Monitor account health through usage data, adoption metrics, contact network and mapping, and stakeholder engagement

  • Maintain accurate forecasting (renewals, churn, upsell potential) and rigorous CRM discipline (Salesforce accuracy and completeness)

Customer Value & Expertise (40%)

Drive measurable value and position UpSlide as a strategic partner:

  • Lead high-impact Business Reviews focused on ROI and value realization

  • Lead complex or sensitive conversations (renegotiation, escalations, dissatisfaction) with confidence and clarity

  • Secure executive sponsors and build multi-threaded relationships within each account

  • Develop and maintain strong product expertise and a deep understanding of client industries and use cases

  • Craft value-driven narratives tailored to each stakeholder's priorities

Cross-functional Collaboration (10%)

Align with internal teams to maximize customer outcomes and business impact:

  • Partner with Sales on the account expansion strategy and account mapping

  • Collaborate with Professional Services when deeper deployment or training support is needed

  • Work closely with Product and Support to relay structured feedback and improve the customer experience

  • Coordinate with CSMs in other regions on shared or global accounts

  • Contribute to Customer Success best practices and performance improvement initiatives

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Microsoft Office, UpSlide, Salesforce, Gong, PowerBI, and Notion (or local equivalents).

⚡Your goals

You will be assessed on:

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

  • Churn

  • Expansion / upsell contribution

  • Depth and health of executive relationships across your portfolio

  • Ability to maintain full ownership and visibility on shared accounts


You are a great fit if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing/revenue role, including managing enterprise or large, multi-entity accounts in a B2B environment

  • Proven experience managing renewals and churn on strategic / enterprise accounts, with meaningful revenue responsibility

  • A proven track record of generating expansion (upsell/cross-sell) within an enterprise account base

  • Experience in autonomously managing a portfolio of large or multi-entity accounts with significant revenue responsibility

  • Confidence leading executive-level conversations, including complex or difficult ones (renegotiation, dissatisfaction, escalations)

  • Advanced negotiation skills

  • A structured, strategic approach to account planning (objectives, stakeholders, action plans)

  • A value- and ROI-oriented mindset, able to build and defend a business case with senior stakeholders

  • Operational rigor: accurate CRM data, reliable follow-up, dependable forecasting

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English and French

  • Comfortable working in an international environment, engaging with senior and executive stakeholders

We’d love it if you have:

  • Experience with a CRM / Customer Success platform (Salesforce, Planhat, or equivalent) and analytics / BI tools (PowerBI or equivalent)

  • Knowledge of the financial services/consulting sector

  • Experience managing group or multi-entity account structures

  • Familiarity with SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, forecasting) and reporting to leadership

  • Fluency in another language (e.g. German)

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Screening call with Talent Acquisition: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role.

  2. Interview with your future manager and a team-meet: A deeper dive into your Customer Success experience and approach to account management. This also includes a live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team.

  3. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: A policy adapted to each team’s rhythm

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

jobs.title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Bordeaux & Gironde)
jobs.description:
Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Bordeaux & Gironde)

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

3 premiers mois :

- Tu te formes sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

🤝 Process de recrutement

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

jobs.title: RF Engineer (GNSS)
jobs.description:
RF Engineer (GNSS)

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As an RF Engineer (GNSS) in the Hardware (Electronics) team, you will own the radionavigation architecture of our products. Our systems need high-precision navigation and robust connectivity in contested, complex environments, and you will be the expert responsible for the RF subsystems, from antenna design to integration and compliance. You will design custom GNSS antennas and receiver modules, extend them towards CRPAs for GNSS-denied operations, and see each design through simulation, lab validation and flight tests. Based in Lausanne, Switzerland.

Responsibilities

  • Antenna Design: Design custom GNSS antennas and receiver modules for our products, and extend the work towards CRPAs (Controlled Reception Pattern Antennas) for GNSS-denied environments.

  • Antenna Integration: Integrate all antennas (GNSS, radio link) into the drones, validating through simulation (gain diagrams) and real-life lab and flight testing.

  • GNSS Test Bench: Develop, maintain and configure the GNSS test bench to simulate satellite constellations and interference scenarios.

  • RF Measurement: Run hands-on characterization with network and spectrum analyzers, and simulate new antenna iterations with EM software.

  • Electromagnetic Compatibility: Lead EMC troubleshooting and pre-compliance testing, identifying and removing blockers early.

  • PCB Collaboration: Work with PCB designers to review routing, shielding and RF layout.

  • Architecture Ownership: Review and own the RF architecture across product lines, including link budgets and system-level RF performance.

  • Mentoring: Act as the team's RF subject matter expert, coaching junior engineers on RF layout principles and EMC mitigation.

Candidate Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field.

  • Experience: Proven track record taking complex wireless devices from concept to mass production, including clearing strict EMC compliance hurdles. Background in aerospace, commercial drones or GNSS products is a strong advantage.

  • GNSS: Solid grounding in GNSS, including hands-on use of a GNSS test bench to simulate edge-case environments, and an understanding of effects such as multipath.

  • Antenna Design: Experience designing custom antennas under tight mechanical and space constraints, with EM simulation tools.

  • RF & EMC: Strong command of RF fundamentals and measurement equipment (network and spectrum analyzers); comfortable working in an anechoic chamber.

  • Mindset: Analytical, meticulous, structured and resilient; a hands-on problem-solver who works autonomously and collaborates well.

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of leading diverse principals, from junior members to senior executives.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.description:
Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Wat ga je doen?

Samen met de CEO en COO werk je aan de verdere strategische en financiële ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Als CFO vertaal je de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete groeikansen door schaalbare verdien- en prijsmodellen te ontwikkelen. Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen.

 

Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Daarbij weeg je beschikbare financieringsopties zorgvuldig af op impact, liquiditeit en rendement. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Met heldere go/no-go-momenten per fase zorg je ervoor dat de ontwikkeling en implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen niet sneller gaat dan wat de organisatie kan adopteren. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Tegelijkertijd borg je dat contracten allesomvattende afspraken en een evenwichtige risicoverdeling bevatten, evenals uitvoerbaar zijn in alle landen waar Voortman Steel Machinery actief is. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn.

 

Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Tevens bewaak je per land en internationale entiteit het rendement, de cashflow, het werkkapitaal en houd je zicht op financiële, juridische, fiscale, contractuele en compliance-risico’s.

Ook de financiële besturing en beheersing van Voortman Steel Machinery valt onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent internationaal eindverantwoordelijk voor consolidatie, planning & control, reporting, accounting, treasury, audit, tax, vennootschapsbelasting en interne beheersing. Aansluitend zie je toe op het opstellen van correcte en transparante rapportages per internationale entiteit. De dagelijkse coördinatie van deze verschillende activiteiten en de aansturing van de Finance-afdeling wordt verzorgd door de Finance-director, waarmee je nauw samenwerkt. Jij fungeert als sparringpartner, stuurt bij waar nodig, bewaakt de strategisch richting van de Finance-afdeling, verzorgt correcte governance en behandeld onderwerpen met board impact. Tevens ben je het gezicht van Voortman Steel Machinery richting banken, verzekeraars, accountant en andere financiële stakeholders.

 

Wat maakt deze rol uniek?

In deze rol krijg je de kans om zichtbaar richting te geven aan de volgende groeifase van Voortman Steel Machinery. Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en slagkracht samenkomen: ideeën worden niet alleen verkend, maar ook scherp getoetst op waardecreatie, rendement, risico en schaalbaarheid. Daarmee krijg je ruimte om jouw financiële expertise en strategisch vermogen in te zetten bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe proposities, het onderbouwen van businesscases en het bepalen van investeringskeuzes die impact hebben op de internationale groei van de organisatie. Dit maakt de functie nadrukkelijk méér dan een traditionele CFO-rol: je bewaakt niet alleen de financiële basis, maar bent medebepalend in hoe Voortman Steel Machinery commerciële kansen vertaalt naar gezonde, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige groei.

 

Positie binnen de organisatie

Voortman Steel Machinery ontwikkelt machines, software en serviceoplossingen waarmee staalverwerkende bedrijven hun productieprocessen automatiseren en optimaliseren. Het hoofdkantoor is gevestigd in Nederland. Dankzij vestigingen in verschillende landen kan effectieve lokale ondersteuning worden geboden. De recent geopende, grootschalige productielocatie in de Verenigde Staten laat zien hoe de organisatie internationaal blijft groeien. Tevens vindt in Engeland hoofdzakelijk de ontwikkeling van onze LogicSteel-software plaats. Daarnaast bezit Voortman wereldwijd diverse sales & service-hubs.

 

Als CFO vorm je samen met de CEO en COO de board van Voortman Steel Machinery, geef je met hen richting aan de ontwikkeling van het Global Management Team en de organisatie als geheel. Jouw focus ligt op het vertalen van de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete kansen voor nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met de afdeling Product Management, dat verantwoordelijk is voor het identificeren en ontwikkelen van software-, machine- en serviceproposities. Als CFO ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de Finance-afdeling en werk je nauw samen met de Finance Director, die de dagelijkse internationale operationele aansturing van de afdeling verzorgt. Tevens rapporteren de HR-Manager en Trade Compliance Officer aan jou. De HR-Manager is (mede) verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van de HR-strategie en het borgen van de operationele uitvoering. Daarnaast ziet de Trade Compliance Officer erop toe dat de organisatie voldoet aan de relevante wet- en regelgeving. Daarbij bewaakt de Trade Compliance Officer onder andere de inhoudelijke juistheid en werking van ingezette maatregelen.


Wat wij bieden?

Bij Voortman Steel Machinery kom je terecht in een écht familiebedrijf met een informele, betrokken en ondernemende cultuur. Mensen kennen elkaar en lijnen zijn kort. Er is volop ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, initiatief te tonen en ideeën verder te brengen. Onze kernwaarden ondernemerschap, vakmanschap, passie voor technologie, toewijding en samenwerking vormen daarbij de basis voor hoe we werken en met elkaar omgaan. Je ziet ze terug in de trots waarmee we hoogwaardige technologie ontwikkelen, in de manier waarop teams elkaar versterken en in de gezamenlijke drive om klanten vooruit te helpen. Zo ontstaat een werkomgeving waarin ambitie, betrokkenheid en werkplezier op een natuurlijke manier samenkomen.

 

Naast een professionele, ondernemende en loyale werkomgeving krijg je bij ons:

  • Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Een passende pensioenregeling bij ASR, waarbij jij en Voortman samen pensioenkapitaal opbouwen;

  • Een leaseauto voor zakelijk en privégebruik;

  • Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze strategie met internationale impact;

  • Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen;

 

Wat breng je mee?

Wij zoeken een ondernemende, strategische en daadkrachtige CFO met een afgeronde masteropleiding in Finance, Economie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting. Een titel als RA, RC of CPA is een must. Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als CFO, Divisie-CFO, Senior Finance Director, Head of Finance of Director Corporate Finance, bij voorkeur binnen een internationale original equipment manufacturer (OEM), industrieel technologiebedrijf, technisch complexe B2B-organisatie of top-tier consultancybureau. Ervaring binnen een ondernemend familiebedrijf of een organisatie van vergelijkbare omvang en complexiteit is daarbij een pré. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met aansturen van een finance-afdeling of -team. Verder voldoe je aan het volgende profiel:

 

  • Strategisch en analytisch vermogen: je beschikt over sterk analytisch en strategisch vermogen en hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het doorgronden van complexe data en businessmodellen. Je weet informatie te vertalen naar heldere strategische en financiële logica, logische transparante aannames en goed onderbouwde besluitvorming. Je bent in staat om richting te bepalen, langetermijndoelen te formuleren en de organisatie daarin mee te nemen.

 

  • Businessmodelinnovatie: je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het in kaart brengen van groeikansen en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe (schaalbare) verdien-, prijs- en contractmodellen. Deze weet je te onderbouwen met solide businesscases en scenarioanalyses. Daarnaast heb je ruime ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financieringsmodellen en het inrichten van kapitaalallocatie op basis van het (verwachte) rendement, risico’s en strategische bijdrage.

 

  • Besluitvaardig en resultaatgericht: je bent besluitvaardig en kunt tijdig en doordacht keuzes maken op basis van beschikbare informatie. Als je éénmaal een keuze hebt gemaakt, durf je achter je keuze te blijven staan. Je beschikt over overtuigingskracht, kunt draagvlak creëren en interne en externe stakeholders zorgvuldig meenemen in strategische veranderingen. Tevens stuur je actief op concrete resultaten en realiseer je aantoonbare positieve financiële impact.

 

  • Verandervermogen en omgevingsbewustzijn: je hebt ervaring met het realiseren van interne veranderingen en de implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen, evenals het tijdig bijsturen daarvan. Tevens ben je sterk in het vertalen van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen naar heldere, beheersbare processen en rollen. Daarbij zorg je voor een gestructureerde stapsgewijze implementatie en ben je sterk in het meenemen en begeleiden van collega’s tijdens veranderingen. Ook onder druk en in complexe situaties blijf je rustig, behoud je overzicht en kun je snel schakelen. Tevens heb je een scherp oog voor verhoudingen, kun je belangen goed afwegen en anticipeer je tijdig op ontwikkelingen. Daarbij heb je een goed begrip van culturele en organisatorische verschillen in een internationale context.

 

  • Verbindend vermogen en communicatie: je bent betrokken en weet duurzame professionele relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden met interne en externe stakeholders, zoals banken, accountants en verzekeraars. Je communiceert helder, informeert betrokkenen tijdig over relevante ontwikkelingen en bent benaderbaar. Je weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk over te brengen en stemt je communicatie af op verschillende gesprekspartners. Daarnaast beschik je over sterke Nederlandse en Engelse communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

 

  • Inspirerend leiderschap: jouw leiderschap is gericht op groei, vertrouwen en ontwikkeling. Je weet medewerkers te coachen, te inspireren en richting te geven, terwijl je ruimte geeft voor eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid. Daarbij stuur je bij waar nodig, stimuleer je samenwerking en help je collega’s hun potentieel te benutten. Zo draag je bij aan een omgeving waarin mensen zich betrokken voelen en werken aan gezamenlijke doelen.

 

  • Onafhankelijke en reflectieve houding: je hebt een onafhankelijke, kritische en constructieve houding, staat open voor feedback, kunt je eigen handelen kritisch evalueren en wilt continu blijven leren.

 

Nieuwsgierig?

Ben jij dé ondernemende en daadkrachtige Chief Financial Officer (CFO) die strategie weet te vertalen naar waarde, nieuwe verdienmodellen tot leven brengt, internationale groei mede realiseert en de organisatie met visie en resultaatgerichtheid stuurt? Solliciteer dan nu en word onderdeel van onze organisatie! Na ontvangst beoordelen wij jouw sollicitatie en nemen we binnen twee werkdagen contact met je op. Zijn wij net als jij positief, dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een eerste sollicitatiegesprek op locatie. Bij een positieve uitkomst volgt een tweede en mogelijk derde sollicitatiegesprek. Ter voorbereiding op het derde sollicitatiegesprek willen we je vragen een assessment te maken, waarmee meer inzicht wordt verkregen in jouw cognitieve capaciteiten, drijfveren en persoonlijkheid. Met jouw goedkeuring bespreken we vervolgens de uitkomsten, behandelen we een casus en wordt een referentie- en achtergrondcheck uitgevoerd. Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie, Voortman Steel Machinery of sollicitatieprocedure, neem dan contact op met Guus Regelink via of 0626393850.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager- Conversational AI
jobs.description:
Principal Product Manager- Conversational AI

About the Role

HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving real customer issues like flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the largest travel brands and enterprises in the world. Voice carries its own product problems, from latency and turn-taking to escalation timing when a human is on the line, and this role owns both surfaces with equal depth.

As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites

  • Set the product bar for voice specifically, covering latency, turn-taking, barge-in handling, localization, realtime voice and ASR/TTS quality, since a caller's tolerance for a bad interaction is lower than a chat user's

  • Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners

  • Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding

  • Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets

  • Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas

  • Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality across both chat and voice

  • Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data

  • Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap

An ideal candidate has

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with direct experience shipping voice-based conversational products such as IVR, voice bots, or contact center voice automation

  • Hands-on ownership of a production voice product, not only chat or text-based conversational AI, with working knowledge of ASR/TTS tradeoffs, latency budgets, and turn-taking or barge-in design. This is a required skillset

  • Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team

  • The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build

  • Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly

  • Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level

  • A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality

  • Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Hopper covers the cost of employee premiums for private medical and dental coverage

  • Hopper also offers private life and accident coverage

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Hopper offers a monthly cash allowance for gym memberships and to cover home office expenses

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams with massive impact

About Hopper
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS's channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to see millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agency in North America, and 70% of our app customers are Gen Z and millennial travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Come take off with us!

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive (US, West Coast)
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive (US, West Coast)

Senior Account Executive — West Coast (Remote, US)

About emnify

emnify is a leading cloud-native IoT connectivity provider helping businesses connect and manage devices globally through a single, modern platform. Our technology powers connected products across industries including mobility, logistics, energy, healthcare, and security — enabling enterprises to scale IoT faster, more securely, and with greater flexibility.

Built for the cloud era, emnify combines global cellular connectivity, network intelligence, and seamless API integrations into one platform that simplifies how businesses deploy and manage connected devices worldwide.

With strong international growth and increasing momentum in the U.S. market, emnify is helping redefine what modern IoT connectivity looks like.

---

Your Role

This is a remote role covering the West Coast territory, sitting within a US sales team of around ten people and reporting directly to the VP of Sales, North America. You will own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and qualification through to close — for new enterprise accounts in your territory. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, and Legal to bring the right resources to bear at the right moments in each deal.

Why emnify

IoT connectivity is moving from fragmented, carrier-dependent infrastructure toward cloud-native platforms — and emnify is at the front of that shift. The US market is a genuine growth priority, not an afterthought, and this territory represents real, buildable opportunity. You will be selling a product with strong technical differentiation into a buyer community that is actively looking for a better answer than what legacy telcos offer. The deals are complex and meaningful, the internal team is lean and collaborative, and the company has hit a series of significant milestones that signal strong commercial momentum. If you want a role where your territory performance is visible and your contribution matters, this is it.

Your Impact

  • Drive new enterprise revenue across the West Coast territory, owning every stage of the sales cycle from first contact to signed contract
  • Build a disciplined, data-driven pipeline using a structured qualification framework and rigorous CRM hygiene, so your forecast is reliable and your activity is repeatable
  • Own commercial negotiations — pricing, competitive positioning, business case development, and contracting — coordinating internal stakeholders to move deals forward
  • Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers and influencers across Line of Business Management, Product, Operations, and Procurement within target accounts
  • Establish a sustainable territory strategy: a clear account prioritisation plan, consistent prospecting motion, and a pipeline that covers future quota periods, not just the current quarter

What We Expect

  • A proven track record of closing complex B2B SaaS or technology deals at the enterprise level, with consistent quota attainment
  • Experience managing and closing deals with ARR above $100k, including navigating multi-stakeholder buying processes and extended sales cycles
  • Fluency in a structured sales methodology — MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN, or similar — and the discipline to apply it consistently rather than selectively
  • Comfort operating in a value-based selling motion: you build business cases, you quantify ROI, and you sell outcomes rather than features
  • Proficiency with CRM and sales tools (Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or equivalents) and a genuine preference for a data-driven approach to managing your territory
  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication — you can adapt your message for a technical buyer, a procurement lead, or a C-suite sponsor
  • Coachability — we want someone who is excited to grow with us

Your First 6 Months

In your first few weeks, the priority is depth over activity. You will complete onboarding, work through product and technical training, and develop a solid grasp of emnify's ideal customer profile, buyer personas, pricing model, and competitive positioning.

By month two or three, you will be prospecting independently — running outbound alongside inbound follow-up, conducting your own discovery calls, and qualifying opportunities against emnify's framework. You will start building pipeline and learning which messages and objections resonate with our buyers. Expect to be generating meetings and managing early-stage opportunities with increasing independence.

By the halfway mark, you should own a live set of opportunities at multiple stages of the funnel. You will be running complete discovery and demo cycles, coordinating Solutions Engineering and other internal resources, producing a reliable forecast, and progressing late-stage deals toward close. Depending on sales-cycle length, this is when first wins typically become possible.

The broader arc is becoming a repeatable, forecastable contributor — someone with a clear territory strategy, consistent prospecting habits, strong internal relationships, and a sharp understanding of why deals are won or lost.

Why It Might Not Be a Match

  • If you prefer a highly structured, process-heavy environment with clearly defined playbooks at every step, you may find emnify's pace and degree of self-direction uncomfortable — we are still building, and we expect this person to help shape how things are done, not just follow an established script
  • If you are most comfortable managing a high volume of smaller, transactional deals, the complexity and longer timelines of enterprise IoT sales cycles may not suit your natural rhythm
  • If you need a large, well-resourced support organisation around you before you feel confident going to market, this role will feel underpowered — the team is lean, which means high ownership and real impact, but also real ambiguity
Full-Time USA

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
Technical Recruiter

Technical Recruiter

Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Our team is small relative to our impact, and we believe our users’ success is our success (not the inverse). A team member summarized: “Roboflow is a company full of giant brains and tiny egos.” We find software has a multiplier effect on all roles (not only product and engineering), so Roboflow employs developers across the company in design, sales, customer support, marketing, and beyond.

We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over $63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, and other leading software investors.

What We're Looking For

Primarily, you like making great things with passionate colleagues. You prefer owning outcomes to completing tasks, and you're motivated by helping exceptional people find work where they can have outsized impact.

You're fascinated by how strong technical organizations are built. You enjoy understanding what makes great engineers, product managers, designers, and researchers effective—and helping hiring teams identify those signals early.

We are less concerned with the number of years you've spent recruiting than with the impact you've had. You know recruiting is not simply about filling open positions. Exceptional hiring compounds across an organization for years. You approach recruiting as a strategic function that helps shape the future of a company.

You are constantly asking, “How can this be better?” Whether improving sourcing approaches, candidate experience, interview design, or recruiting systems, you look for opportunities to raise the bar.

You understand how strong product and technical teams operate. You can distinguish genuine technical depth from interview performance and help hiring managers identify candidates who raise the bar rather than merely fill a role.

What You'll Do

As a Technical Recruiter, you'll own hiring across Product, Engineering, Design, and Research.

Success in this role means consistently identifying and hiring exceptional builders, creating candidate experiences that reflect Roboflow’s values, and improving the systems that help us scale hiring without sacrificing quality. You'll earn the trust of hiring managers, help shape hiring strategy, and ensure we continue building a team that ships quickly, cares deeply about users, and raises the bar for excellence.

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across Product, Engineering, Design, and Research

  • Partner with hiring managers to define success profiles, interview loops, and hiring strategy

  • Build and maintain high-quality pipelines through sourcing, networking, referrals, and creative outreach

  • Develop conviction around candidate quality through structured assessment and evidence-based evaluation

  • Create exceptional candidate experiences from first conversation through close

  • Improve recruiting systems, processes, and tooling to increase hiring quality and efficiency

  • Partner with leadership on workforce planning and future hiring needs

  • Continuously refine how Roboflow attracts, evaluates, and hires technical talent

  • Take ownership of recruiting initiatives and strategic projects aligned with your experience and strengths, helping improve how Roboflow attracts, evaluates, and hires exceptional technical talent

Who You Are

  • Demonstrated success recruiting technical talent in startup, SaaS, AI, developer-tool, or related technology environments. We are open to candidates across multiple experience levels, from experienced individual contributors to senior recruiting operators with a track record of shaping hiring strategy and recruiting systems.

  • Experience hiring software engineers, machine learning engineers, researchers, product managers, designers, or similarly technical roles

  • Strong sourcing instincts and a track record of building high-quality candidate pipelines

  • Ability to evaluate technical and product-oriented candidates beyond keyword matching and résumé screening

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Proven ability to earn trust with hiring managers, challenge assumptions when necessary, and drive hiring decisions through sound judgment and evidence

  • Strong operational rigor and ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously while maintaining exceptional candidate communication

  • Curiosity about technology and enthusiasm for learning how technical teams operate

  • Bias toward action, ownership, and continuous improvement

Where You'll Work

Named Technical Support Engineer

Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

Who You Are

You are a technically strong Support Engineer who thrives on becoming deeply embedded in a single strategic enterprise customer account. Rather than servicing a broad queue, you prefer owning intimate context: their workflows, edge infrastructure, data pipelines, and operational rhythms. You naturally build long-term trusted relationships, understand customer environments at a granular level, and act as the local regional representative of Roboflow’s platform.

You enjoy teaching just as much as troubleshooting. You run bitesize enablement sessions, create tailored guides and internal customer knowledge bases, and help your customer mature their computer vision operations.

What You’ll Do

Technical Proficiency

Who You'll Be Working With

You will work closely with our Field Engineering, Product and Account Executives. Within the customer, you’ll collaborate with engineering, ML practitioners, operators, and program leads—acting as the connective tissue that ensures clarity, continuity, and forward progress.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is a distributed team across the US, with hubs in New York City and San Francisco. You are free to work from a hub, your home office, or anywhere you work best, however the role requires being based in the US. As a regional representative, occasional customer onsite visits may occur depending on need and location.

When You'll Work

You will generally align with the customer's regional operating hours.

What You'll Receive:

The target compensation for this role is $150K - $200k OTE- this uncapped.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

Within one week, you will…

jobs.title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer

Signal Processing & Data Engineer

Who We Are

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

What You'll Do

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

  • Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production
  • Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.
  • Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.
  • Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.
  • Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.

What You Bring

  • Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.
  • Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.
  • Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.
  • Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.
  • Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.

Why Limatica

  • Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.
  • Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.
  • Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.
  • Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning
  • Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages

What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.

Ready to find the signal in the noise? Let's build the future of battery diagnostics together. ⚡

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role Description
As a Real Estate Analyst at Checkout.com, you will provide dedicated administrative, data management, and operational support to the Head of Real Estate, focusing on mitigating risk and increasing efficiency across the global portfolio. This role is essential for managing high-risk operational tasks, such as lease event tracking, lease administration, budgeting and data reporting to ensure a structured approach and prevent critical errors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lease Administration & Governance

  • Proactively track, monitor, and manage critical dates for all lease events, including renewals and break clauses, acting as the primary conduit for populating and managing the tools that host our Real Estate data.

  • Support the execution of Real Estate contracts by coordinating with Brokers, Procurement, Legal etc. to finalise signing, updating project budgets, and archiving completed agreements.

  • Manage operational risk by ensuring all key details related to lease obligations are accurately recorded, tracked and action is taken.

  • For business case generation, gather comparable evidence, property valuations, and market data to drive strategic negotiations.

  • Liaise with regional, business and central teams to capture the justification and data necessary for business case approval.

  • Manage subleasing activities, including monitoring sub-tenant compliance, tracking sublease income and key milestones, and coordinating with legal and property management teams.

2. Financial and Procurement Reporting

  • Coordinate with Finance, Tax and Procurement teams for Real Estate budgets, including updating and managing the Real Estate OPEX and CAPEX budget tracking tools.

  • Act as the central point of contact for all property-related budget reporting, preparing quarterly reviews in a clear, digestible format that includes Real Estate and Workplace costs - giving an all inclusive cost per desk / square foot / head.

  • Assist in reporting refurbishment or new office delivery costs, against business as usual spend for operational office locations.

  • Support the coordination of financial and legal documentation required for transactions, such as preparing group structure charts and financials for external parties (e.g., landlords).

3. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Data Collation

  • Lead the coordination and collection of energy, water, and utility consumption data across the global portfolio to support future CSR reporting requirements.

  • Manage the challenge of obtaining utility data in co-working and serviced spaces where direct meter readings are complex, including liaising with local teams, operators and landlords to gather the necessary information.

  • Act as the conduit between the CEO Office and ESG/CSR teams to ensure our portfolio meets the needs of Sustainability policies and or regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain the central digital repository for all property documentation (leases, contracts, floor plans, and insurance certificates), ensuring strict naming conventions, accessibility, and version control are met to ensure 100% audit-readiness.

Rattaché(e) à l’équipe CRM, vos principales responsabilités seront :

jobs.description:
Senior Growth Manager - 60 à 75K package + BSPCE

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents for medical practices: they answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, and free up time for care teams. 250 healthcare organizations use Vocca today, and we are a team of 50+ across Paris and New York.

In France we sell to imaging centers, to networks and health centers, and to independent practices. We have tested many acquisition channels without measuring them properly, so we can't say which one works best or for which type of practice. Our website is made to be read: a visitor can't try the product, estimate a return on investment or compare us with the alternatives. In the US, paid acquisition starts from zero.

The target is set: 100 MQLs in Q4 2026, then +30% every quarter. We are hiring the person who will own that number. You report to Pierre, Head of Marketing.

Your mission

Build Vocca's inbound lead engine. You own paid acquisition and website conversion, in France first and then in the US, and you are accountable for the quarterly MQL target: 100 in Q4 2026 and about 285 per quarter by the end of 2027.

Expected outcomes

After 1 months:

  • Tracking and attribution work: every lead has a source and a cost, and can be followed in the CRM up to the signed deal

  • Google Ads and Meta accounts audited and rebuilt, with campaigns live for each segment

  • A first ranking of channels by cost per MQL, and budget moved accordingly

  • The first conversion pages live on the website

After 3 months:

  • The quarterly MQL target is met and on the +30% trajectory

  • Cost per MQL and MQL-to-opportunity rate known for each channel and segment

  • ROI calculator, comparison pages and a way to try the product live on the website

  • Email and SMS nurturing running on leads who are not ready to buy yet

  • A tested approach to practitioner communities, starting with dentists' Facebook groups

After 9 months:

  • About 285 MQLs per quarter, close to three times the Q4 2026 level

  • Paid acquisition live in the US, with a first read on cost per lead

  • A channel mix the sales team trusts, with lead quality reviewed with them on a regular basis

What you will own

Paid acquisition (the core of the job)

  • Run the Google Ads and Meta campaigns yourself, and test other paid channels when the numbers justify it

  • Own the budget: split it by segment and channel, and cut what doesn't convert

  • Write and test ads and landing pages without waiting for a brief

  • Open paid acquisition in the US

Website and conversion

  • Turn the website into something visitors can act on: ROI calculator, comparison pages, product trial, lead magnets

  • Build and test landing pages for each segment and specialty

  • Work with our web agency, which runs SEO and GEO, so that paid and organic use the same keywords and pages

Nurturing and communities

  • Run email and SMS campaigns to leads and prospects. RevOps owns the tools and the CRM sync, you own the messages and the calendar

  • Join the communities where practitioners talk to each other and turn them into a source of leads

  • Try new channels as they appear and drop them quickly when they don't pay

Measurement

  • Report cost per MQL, conversion to opportunity and revenue for each channel

  • Agree with sales on what a qualified lead is, and review lead quality with them

  • Tell the team every month where the next euro should go

This role is for you if

Must have:

  • 4 to 7 years in growth or performance marketing with paid acquisition as your strongest skill. You have run Google Ads and Meta accounts yourself, on real budgets, and you can show the results

  • You are a generalist out of curiosity. Beyond ads, you have built landing pages, set up tracking and written email sequences, and you prefer learning a tool to briefing someone else on it

  • Fluent French and professional English.

What we will assess:

  • Numbers: you think in cost per lead, conversion rate and payback, and you can explain a campaign you stopped and why

  • Doing it yourself: you build the campaign, the page and the automation, with AI and no-code tools when they save time

  • Curiosity: you test channels nobody asked you to test

  • Ownership: you have one number, and you say so early when it is off track

  • Closeness to sales: you care about what happens to a lead after the form is filled in

  • B2B lead generation for a SaaS product, experience marketing to healthcare professionals or small businesses

  • Nice to have: paid campaigns on the US market.

This role is NOT for you if

  • You want to specialize in one channel and stay on it

  • You manage agencies and freelancers and no longer operate the accounts yourself

  • You are looking for a brand or content role

Compensation and benefits

  • 60-75K package

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with 8 to 12 RTT days per year

  • Hybrid: 3 days per week at our Paris office

  • MacBook provided

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company)

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered; public transport: 50% of Navigo covered; EGYM Wellpass

  • Annual offsite and team events throughout the year

Hiring process

  1. Video call with our Head of Talent Acquisition (30 min)

  2. Video interview with Pierre, Head of Marketing (45 min)

  3. On site Technical interview: a paid acquisition case, with Pierre

  4. Interview with Eliott, CEO or Maxime Chief of Staff

  5. Reference checks

  6. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!
