jobs.title: People & Workplace Experience Manager
jobs.description:
People & Workplace Experience Manager

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

Dust is growing fast, and we want every person who joins us to feel welcome, supported, connected and able to do their best work. As our People Experience Manager, you'll shape how people experience Dust, from their first day and the moments that bring us together to the way our offices in Paris, London, New York and San Francisco support the team.

We're looking for someone who is operationally excellent and creatively ambitious. You'll handle the details carefully, and you'll also look for ways to make the employee experience much better. One day you might be redesigning part of onboarding, the next planning a company offsite, acting on survey feedback, or working with a site lead to improve one of our offices.

This role works as a partner across the company. You'll work most closely with People Operations, who lead on the core people processes. Together, you'll make sure the employee experience is well run behind the scenes and thoughtful in how people actually experience it. In Paris, you'll also work closely with our Office Manager, who runs our HQ on site and leads much of our day-to-day office life and events. In London, New York and San Francisco, you'll coordinate with local site leads. You'll also work with IT, Finance, Legal, Marketing, leadership and outside partners. Your guiding principle: consistency where it matters, local adaptation where it creates a better experience.

What you will do:

Own the employee journey

  • Own the onboarding experience end to end, working closely with our People Ops Specialist, from pre-boarding and equipment to first-day logistics and the first few weeks, so new joiners can contribute from day one in every location.

  • Work with People Ops, IT, Finance, hiring managers, our Paris Office Manager and site leads so every handoff in the employee journey is smooth.

  • Partner with People Ops and IT on offboarding, so people leave with the same care they got when they joined.

  • Be a trusted point of contact for everyday employee questions and needs, and know when to bring in People Ops.

Build culture and community

  • Run and improve our team rituals, including weekly lunches, team drinks, dinners and company gatherings.

  • Organise one or two company offsites or retreats each year.

  • Create moments that help people connect, celebrate progress and feel they belong, across offices and time zones.

  • Pay attention to the details that make experiences feel personal and inclusive, such as dietary needs, accessibility, preferences and team milestones.

  • Partner with People and Marketing on selected external and brand-building events.

Listen and turn feedback into action

  • Build feedback loops (surveys, conversations, informal check-ins) to understand how people experience Dust.

  • Turn what people tell us into concrete recommendations and visible improvements.

  • Define and track simple, useful measures of employee and workplace experience.

  • Communicate clearly and consistently about updates, events, practical information and team norms. Be assertive when needed.

Shape our workplaces

  • Make sure our offices are safe, welcoming, functional and ergonomic, and that they reflect how we want people to feel at Dust.

  • Work with our office manager on day-to-day operations: supplies, maintenance, access, equipment and services.

  • Manage workplace vendors, contracts and budget, and look for efficient ways to improve the experience.

  • Spot operational needs early and fix issues before they disrupt anyone.

Scale the experience as Dust grows

  • Help shape how our physical, hybrid and digital environments evolve as the company grows.

  • Set up simple, scalable processes and clear ownership across People, IT, Finance and Legal topics.

  • Keep the employee experience personal and high quality without making it bureaucratic.


What success looks like

After your first 100 days, you will have:

  • Built a smooth, consistent onboarding experience for every new joiner, in every location.

  • Delivered team rituals, events and offsites that strengthen connection and culture.

  • Set up feedback loops and a practical set of metrics that guide People Experience decisions.

  • Created well-run, welcoming offices where operational issues are handled quickly and proactively.

  • Established clear processes and ownership across People, workplace, IT, Finance and Legal.

  • Helped Dust grow its employee experience without it becoming bureaucratic or impersonal.

What we are looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in People Operations, People Experience, Workplace Experience in a fast growing, globally distributed environment

  • A proactive generalist who can handle many kinds of work at once without losing sight of the bigger picture.

  • Real ideas, sound judgement and the confidence to improve how things work today.

  • Strong operational ownership, project management skills and attention to detail.

  • Warmth, empathy and a genuine interest in helping people feel comfortable and connected.

  • Clear, direct, thoughtful communication, and discretion with sensitive situations.

  • Confidence working with vendors, budgets and outside partners.

  • The ability to build simple processes that scale, and to keep a high bar for quality while staying pragmatic.

  • Comfort with a fast-moving environment where priorities can change, working on your own while collaborating across the company.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Engage prospects through high-velocity in-person meetings, outreach, and tailored presentations to convert them into loyal customers.

Nicht nur auf Slides. Nicht nur auf Instagram.

Schnell. Sichtbar. Greifbar. Skalierbar.

Principal Engineer - Platform & Data

About Us_

We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

A particular focus for this role is strengthening our data architecture, how we structure, use and build on the data our platform generates.

jobs.title: Sales Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
Sales Compensation Analyst

At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

Why this role matters

Sales, channel, renewals, BDR, and corporate bonus participants across Semperis count on being paid correctly and on time. As our Senior Sales Compensation Analyst, you'll own the system and the monthly cycle that make that happen. You'll run calculations in Xactly Incent, tie every result back to its source data, and give Finance a close it can trust. The hardest part of the job is judgment: knowing when a variance is a data fix you can make yourself, and when it's a plan question that needs a leader's approval before anything moves.

What you'll own

· Run the recurring commission and incentive calculation cycle, from source data validation to an approved payment file delivered to Payroll within the monthly close window.

· Investigate and resolve discrepancies in assignments, splits, credits, quotas, rates, currencies, and adjustments, and document every true up and correction before payment is released.

· Reconcile Xactly Incent against Salesforce, HR, payroll, and Finance systems each month and quarter, and support close, including commission accruals, in partnership with our Revenue Analyst.

· Build and maintain audit ready documentation and controls so the commission process is repeatable and any reviewer can follow it.

· Administer Xactly Incent across all company plans, keeping participant data, access, hierarchies, quotas, rates, and plan assignments current as people join, move, and leave.

· Lead the annual implementation of every compensation plan in Xactly, working with Revenue Operations and the Global Compensation Director through configuration, testing, and approvals.

· Own plan letter administration end to end, from preparation and issuance through signature tracking.

· Turn large datasets into clear reporting on attainment, commissions, and payments, and help managers and employees understand their plans and statements, including findings they may not want to hear.

What success looks like

· Every cycle closes on time, with an approved payment file and every discrepancy investigated and documented before sign off.

· Each period ties out across systems, with variances explained and evidence ready for auditors.

· Every approved plan is configured, tested, and live before the plan year opens, and every participant holds a current signed plan letter.

· Participants understand their statements, and disputes are resolved with facts rather than escalation.

Who you'll work with

You'll report to our Director of Finance and work closely with the CFO, Revenue Operations leaders and plan owners, and department heads across sales and channel. You'll also partner with HR, Legal, Payroll, Accounting, FP&A, our Xactly technical account manager, and external auditors.

What you'll bring

· 3-5 years of relevant experience in incentive compensation or commission operations

· Hands on experience administering Xactly Incent, including plan configuration, participant data, hierarchies, quotas, and rates

· Strong reconciliation skills, with a track record of tracing variances to root cause across multiple systems

· Advanced Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and lookups

· Experience maintaining documented procedures and audit evidence

· Clear, steady communication when explaining plan mechanics or delivering unwelcome findings

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

· Experience with Workday and NetSuite

· Experience supporting global incentive programs across multiple countries or currencies

· Experience in a public company, high tech or SaaS environment,

· Familiarity with US GAAP including ASC 606, and background in variable pay payroll, Sales or Revenue Operations, accounting, audit or financial analysis.

#LI-MR1

jobs.title: IT-Systemadministrator (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
IT-Systemadministrator (w/m/d)

Einleitung

Wir sind auf der Suche nach neuen Kollegen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Prozess der Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht, unserer juristischen Kompetenz und einem starken Team von zahlreichen Mitarbeitern begleiten wir tausende Mandanten erfolgreich auf dem Weg zur deutschen Staatsbürgerschaft. Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich einen Einblick unter migrando(.)de/karriere, unserer Karriere-Page. Denn wir können hier schreiben was wir wollen, im Endeffekt bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang in der Praxis gearbeitet und Hands-on-Erfahrungen gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Wir bieten Dir

Keine starren Prozesse, kein Mikromanagement. Bei uns entscheidest du, wie du arbeitest – mit Tools, die du selbst mitgestalten darfst, und Kollegen, die mitdenken. Wir entwickeln ständig neue Systeme, um unsere Arbeit zu optimieren, statt nur irgendwelche Tickets zu schließen. Und falls doch mal was brennt: Wir löschen gemeinsam.

  • High-End Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook oder Windows-Tower. Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, inkl. 4K-Monitoren.
  • Echte Eigenverantwortung:
    Du bist nicht einer von vielen in einer langen Zuständigkeitskette. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich in deinem Bereich – mit kurzem Draht zu allen Teams und zur Geschäftsführung, ohne drei Hierarchieebenen dazwischen.
  • Kleine Teams statt Großraumbüro
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt und schnell ins Gespräch kommt.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und keinen anderen stört), kannst du auch gerne Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen in den Räumen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch. Einen Einblick in unsere Räumlichkeiten kannst du dir auf unserer Website anschauen.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit moderner Ausstattung
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, ein leistungsstarker Laptop und eine ruhige Umgebung.
  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Gleichzeitig ist Home Office jederzeit möglich. Auch spontan und ohne lange Abstimmung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit ohne Kernzeiten
    Bei uns gibt es keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster, in denen du anwesend sein musst.
  • Flexible Teilzeitmodelle
    Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell. Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Spontan Urlaub nehmen
    Manchmal braucht man einfach eine Auszeit. Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen.
  • Familienfreundliche Kultur
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend oder kurzfristiger Arzttermin – wir wissen, dass solche Situationen zum Alltag gehören. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Kurze Wege
    Bei uns musst du dich nicht durch die Hierarchien hangeln oder lange Mails schreiben, um gehört zu werden. Du kannst jederzeit direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung sprechen. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Austausch ist direkt und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Mitgestalten statt nur abarbeiten
    Wir suchen Kolleg:innen, die mitdenken. Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie ein Prozess besser laufen kann, ein Tool sinnvoll wäre oder ein Workflow smarter funktionieren könnte, dann wirst du gehört.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Tätigkeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit – es ist Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung und spürbarer Wirkung.
  • Feel-Good-Angebote im Haus
    Unsere Feel-Good-Managerin sorgt regelmäßig für kleine Auszeiten – von Nacken- und Schultermassagen über kurze Entspannungs- und Beauty-Sessions bis hin zu Momenten zum Durchatmen.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events
    Wir feiern gern. Sommerfest am See, gemütliche Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner mit der Abteilung. Unsere Events sorgen dafür, dass wir als Team zusammenwachsen und den Arbeitsalltag auch mal beiseiteschieben können. Aber keine Sorge: Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht und eher Gehen auch kein Problem.
  • Fitnessraum im Haus
    Unser eigener Fitnessraum steht dir direkt im Haus zur Verfügung – kostenlos, gut ausgestattet und jederzeit zugänglich.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Du planst, betreust und entwickelst Systeme, die unser Unternehmen voranbringen. Du kümmerst dich um Server, Netzwerke und Sicherheit – und hast dabei alle Freiheiten, Prozesse smarter zu machen.

  • Verwaltung und Pflege
    Du betreust unsere internen Server, kümmerst dich um Updates, Backups und stellst sicher, dass alle Systeme stabil laufen.
  • Netzwerkadministration
    Du überwachst und konfigurierst Router, Switches, Firewalls und VPNs.
  • Datensicherung & Wiederherstellung
    Du planst, überprüfst und testest Backups regelmäßig. Du stellst sicher, dass im Ernstfall keine Daten verloren gehen.
  • Technischer Support im Alltag
    Du bist eine der ersten Anlaufstellen bei IT-Fragen und hilfst Kollegen bei Problemen weiter. Per Chat oder vor Ort.
  • Einrichtung neuer Arbeitsplätze
    Du richtest neue PCs, Notebooks und Monitore ein, kümmerst dich um Softwareinstallationen und Netzwerkeinstellungen.
  • Systemmigrationen
    Du planst und begleitest den Umstieg auf neue Systeme. Sei es ein Update, neue Software oder neue Hardware.
  • Neue Technologien evaluieren
    Du testest neue Tools, prüfst ihre Praxistauglichkeit und empfiehlst, was uns wirklich weiterbringt.
  • Abstimmung mit Dienstleistern
    Du betreust externe Anbieter, Partner oder Remote-Entwickler und stimmst deine Arbeit mit ihnen ab.
  • Schnittstellen & Automatisierungen
    Du verbindest Systeme über APIs oder Tools wie N8N. So machst du Prozesse effizienter und reduzierst Klickarbeit und Fehler auf ein Minimum.
  • Domainmanagement
    Du hast einen Überblick über unsere aktiven Website-Domains und bist in der Lage, interne Tools lokal oder online für genau die richtigen Teams sicher und performant zur Verfügung zu stellen.

Dein Profil

Kein Zertifikat der Welt ersetzt echte Erfahrung in der Praxis. Genau die suchen wir. Ob du sie im Job, in eigenen Projekten oder auf eigene Faust gesammelt hast – uns interessiert, was du wirklich kannst, was du bereits in dem Bereich gemacht hast und was du noch erreichen willst. Direkte Kommunikation, Lernbereitschaft sowie Spaß und Neugier an der Arbeit sind uns wichtiger als jeder Abschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der IT-Administration oder ähnlichen Bereichen mit.
  • Lokale Netzwerke, Cloud-Server, API-Schnittstellen, Automatisierung und VPNs sind für dich keine Fremdwörter.
  • Wenn du zusätzlich Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen hast – umso besser!
  • Du hast Grundkenntnisse in Systemarchitektur, Netzwerken oder Serverlandschaften.
  • Du findest lieber nachhaltige Lösungen als schnelle Workarounds.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Google Workspace, Windows, MacOS, Docker, Datenbanken (Supabase) oder ähnlichen Plattformen.
  • Du kennst dich mit Netzwerken, Firewalls und/oder VPNs aus.
  • Du hast Lust, regelmäßig Neues zu lernen – ob Tools, Trends oder Technologien.
  • Du hast einen Plan von Backup-Strategien, weisst, wie mit Personenbezogenen Daten umzugehen ist (Speicherung, Verarbeitung, Löschung) und verstehst, wie man einen authentifizierten API-Call macht.
  • Du musst kein Studium oder 30 Weiterbildungen haben. Wir wollen Talente und fähige neue Kollegen finden. Selbst wenn du nicht alle Punkte hier erfüllst - wir sind auf der Suche nach erfahrenen und verantwortungsbewussten Kollegen, idealerweise bist du schon viele Jahre in dem Bereich aktiv und konntest viele Learnings mitnehmen. Denn genau daran sind wir interessiert: saubere, langfristig robuste Problemlösungen. Und die hat man meist erst, nachdem man es einige Zeit auf die harte Tour lernen musste.
  • Du bist kommunikativ und offen. Eigentlich wollen wir hier keine generischen Sachen schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist wichtig. Gute Zusammenarbeit ist oft ebenso wichtig wie reine Erfahrung. Ein Kollege, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos ist, kann im Alltag wertvoller sein als jemand mit mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber eher schleppend ist.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch oder am besten beides (ca. B2-Level). Keine Sorge, wir erwarten keinen Nachweis des Sprachniveaus.

HR Generalist (London)

Coder is growing from about 220 to 500 people by the end of 2027, and our People team is growing with us. We work in pods (GTM, R&D, G&A), each with its own HRBP and Generalist, so leaders always know who to call.

Our London entity is already up and running, so you'll keep the international employee experience running smoothly, help it mature, and work closely with the HRBPs on anything complex.

  • Be the primary day-to-day HR contact for GTM employees, including UK and EOR employees

jobs.description:
Junior Technical Integration Manager

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Junior Technical Integration Manager in our Partnerships team (Hybrid in London, UK).

Partners send us thousands of small businesses each month looking for finance, using our Lending API embedded in the apps those businesses already use. You’ll be the person who makes those integrations work: guiding partners’ developers through the build, fixing what breaks, and turning what partners need — and what we learn from them — into what we build next. You don’t need to arrive with extensive experience of debugging API’s, but you do need to be curious and open to learning whatever it takes to help partners.

The team

The Partnerships team puts iwoca’s lending inside the platforms small businesses already use — banking apps, accounting software, payment providers and comparison sites— through our Lending API. Partners range from recognisable global names to one-person businesses, and each one needs its integration to work differently. The team’s job is to grow those partnerships and to keep the journey from a partner’s app to a funded loan as short as it can be. You will also work very closely with our Partner Flow team, who build and maintain the Lending API and any features partners need.

The role

You’ll be the main contact for partners’ developers, helping them with all things API. You’ll need to be curious, meticulous, and happy working under your own steam.

Mastery: become the person who knows the Lending API best

  • Learn the Lending API end to end — every endpoint, webhook and failure mode.

  • Guide a partner’s engineers from sandbox, to live and any ongoing optimisations. Shaping the integration they build along the way.

  • Review partner customer journeys and tell them what to change to get more businesses funded.

  • Triage live integration issues, trace them through the logs and code, and work with Partner Flow engineers on the fix.

Influence: turn what partners tell you into what we build

  • Own the technical relationship with each partner, from their engineers to their commercial leads.

  • Pitch new API features to partners alongside our commercial team, and make the case for why they’d move the numbers.

  • Be the partners’ voice inside iwoca — collect what they need and push it onto the roadmap.

Ownership: run the systems the whole partner channel depends on

  • Build the monitoring that tells us an integration is degrading before a partner has to tell us, then analyse and investigate what’s going wrong.

  • Dig into integration performance data to find the problems nobody has reported yet.

  • Own our public API documentation and make it the reason partners choose to build with us.

The requirements

Essential:

  • A degree in a technical or scientific subject — computer science, engineering, maths, physics or similar

  • An understanding and interest in how APIs work — enough to follow the logic in a partner’s integration.

  • Clear, concise communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike, and the credibility to manage a partner’s expectations.

  • An analytical approach that gets to the root of a problem, not just the symptom.

  • Commercial sense to judge which problems, and which partners, are worth your time first.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to investigate, analyse and get to answers faster.

Bonus:

  • Experience in a partner-facing or customer-facing technical role.

  • Experience reading API documentation or debugging an integration yourself, even on a side project.

  • Basic coding experience.

The salary

We expect to pay £32,500 - £37,500 (+20% quarterly OTE bonus) for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

 

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Seeq builds advanced analytics software that unlocks insights from industrial process data—empowering companies in sectors like pharmaceuticals, oil & gas, chemicals, and power generation to optimize operations and drive business value.

As a key customer-facing team member, you will participate in the following activities:

  • Be a product expert, maintaining knowledge of how to implement and troubleshoot solutions in the platform, including integrations with other systems.

  • Ability to assess and position Seeq’s benefits relative to competitive products in the marketplace or in the customer’s ecosystem.
  • Work with the product team to design, implement, and test new functionalities that meet customer needs.

  • Build trust with customers through the application of industry-specific knowledge and awareness, including market and use case trends specific to their area. 
  • Collaborate with internal teams (including industry principals, product marketing, and solution consulting) to influence industry-specific strategy.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in a technical field such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering; degrees in operations research, data analytics, or applied math will be considered.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in process engineering, reliability engineering, technical pre-sales engineering (SaaS business, OT space preferred), or other related industry fields.

  • Prior experience using Seeq is highly preferred.

Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments.

We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability.

We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

jobs.title: (Junior) System Engineer

(Junior) System Engineer

“Your next step in IT starts where people and technology connect.” 

Ben jij graag zichtbaar bij klanten, krijg je energie van Microsoft 365, Intune en werkplekbeheer en vind je het leuk om gebruikers écht verder te helpen? 

 

Als Junior System Engineer ben jij het technische én persoonlijke aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten op locatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat gebruikers prettig kunnen werken en dat hun moderne werkomgeving goed wordt beheerd. Dit is geen functie waarbij je de hele week op afstand tickets wegwerkt. Je brengt het grootste deel van je werkdagen door bij onze klanten op locatie. Daardoor leer je de organisatie, de gebruikers en hun IT-omgeving echt kennen. Je ziet wat er speelt, lost problemen op en signaleert verbeteringen voordat ze grotere problemen worden. Je staat er daarbij niet alleen voor. Je bent onderdeel van een vast klantenteam en werkt nauw samen met je collega’s binnen dat team en met de Servicedesk. Je hoeft niet voor ieder technisch vraagstuk zelf de specialist te zijn. Juist omdat je onderdeel bent van een klantenteam, weet je wanneer je iets zelf kunt oplossen en wanneer je een collega of specialist moet aanhaken. 

 

Jouw rol als Junior System Engineer:

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: 

  • Het ondersteunen van gebruikers bij vragen en verstoringen; 

  • Het beheren van Windows-werkplekken en mobiele devices; 

  • Het werken met Microsoft 365, Intune en Entra ID en, afhankelijk van de klant, met SCCM; 

  • Het uitvoeren van de onboarding en offboarding van gebruikers; 

  • Het installeren, configureren, vervangen en uitgeven van werkplekken en apparatuur; 

  • Het oppakken van incidenten, service requests en changes; 

  • Het ondersteunen bij migraties, roll-outs en andere wijzigingen binnen de werkplekomgeving; 

  • Het actueel houden van tickets, klantdocumentatie en assetinformatie; 

  • Het signaleren van terugkerende problemen, risico’s en mogelijkheden om de dienstverlening te verbeteren; 

  • Het afstemmen van bevindingen en vervolgacties met collega’s binnen je klantenteam. 

 

Wat breng jij mee? 

  • Een afgeronde mbo-4-opleiding in de richting van IT of een vergelijkbaar werk- en denkniveau; 

  • Bij voorkeur 1 tot 2 jaar ervaring binnen werkplekbeheer of minimaal 2 jaar ervaring op een Servicedesk; 

  • Kennis van Microsoft Windows en Microsoft 365; 

  • Ervaring met of kennis van Microsoft Intune en/of SCCM; 

  • Affiniteit met Entra ID en moderne werkplekomgevingen; 

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden; 

  • Een klantgerichte, proactieve en zelfstandige werkhouding; 

  • Rijbewijs B, omdat werken bij klanten op locatie een belangrijk onderdeel van je functie is. 

We verwachten niet dat je alles al beheerst. Belangrijker is dat je een goede technische basis hebt, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en gemotiveerd bent om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. 

Meer weten over werken bij Interstellar?
We kunnen je hier natuurlijk alles vertellen over onze cultuur, collega’s, events, ontwikkelmogelijkheden en hoe je eerste weken eruitzien. Maar eerlijk is eerlijk: dat zie je beter op onze werkenbij-site.

  • Hoe is het om bij ons te werken? Lees meer over onze cultuur en collega’s

  • Stage of afstuderen? Bekijk wat we organiseren voor studenten en starters

  • Onze verhalen Lees blogs en ervaringen van collega’s

  • Solliciteren? Hier vind je meer over het sollicitatieproces


Wat bieden wij 

Natuurlijk bieden we bij Interstellar arbeidsvoorwaarden. Want naast het hebben van leuke collega’s, begrijpen we dat er nog meer dingen heel belangrijk zijn. Om ervoor te zorgen dat jij je werk zo goed mogelijk kunt doen, krijg je van ons: 

  • Een salaris gebaseerd op jouw kennis en ervaring; 

  • Een eigen laptop; 

  • 8% vakantiegeld per jaar en 25 vakantiedagen op basis van een werkweek van 40 uur; 

  • Een contract voor bepaalde tijd, met uitzicht op een vast contract; 

  • Een leaseauto van de zaak; 

  • Gratis lunch en altijd vers fruit op al onze locaties; 

  • Een informele werksfeer, waarbij je zelf de verantwoordelijkheid draagt voor de indeling van je werkdag; 

  • Een groots zomer- en kerstfeest waar collega’s vanuit het hele land bij elkaar komen; 

  • Mogelijkheid tot deelname aan verschillende sportevenementen; 

  • Via onze Interstellar Academy volop ruimte om jezelf technisch en persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen. 

Sollicitatieproces

Zien wij dezelfde match, dan plannen we eerst een telefonische intake met je in, waarna een gesprek op een van onze kantoren volgt. Heb je nog vragen? Neem dan contact op met onze recruiter: . jobs.title: Director of Pricing & Monetization
jobs.description:
Director of Pricing & Monetization

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, the Canadian fintech company accelerating the business of clients around the world. Nuvei's modular, flexible and scalable technology allows leading companies to accept next-gen payments, offer all payout options and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 50 markets, 150 currencies and 700 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally with one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service.   We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission 

We are looking for a Director of Pricing & Monetization, who will be responsible for defining and executing the company's pricing strategy to maximize revenue growth, profitability, and market competitiveness. This leader will develop scalable pricing frameworks, design bundled product offerings, lead willingness-to-pay research, and establish a data-driven approach to pricing across products, industries, customer segments, and geographies. The role sits at the intersection of Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics & Product, ensuring pricing decisions balance customer value, competitive positioning, profitability, and growth objectives. 

Responsibilities 

Pricing Framework Development 

  • Design and maintain the company's enterprise-wide pricing framework. 
  • Develop attribute-based pricing models across products, industries, geographies, customer segments, and risk profiles. 
  • Establish pricing governance, policies, guardrails, and decision-making frameworks. 
  • Create methodologies for standard pricing, exception pricing, strategic discounts, and deal approvals. 
  • Define pricing architecture for new products and market launches. 

Bundling & Monetization Strategy 

  • Design and implement bundled product and service offerings that maximize customer value and company profitability. 
  • Identify opportunities to unbundle and re-bundle products to improve monetization and customer segmentation. 
  • Develop packaging strategies across core products, value-added services, premium features, and subscriptions. 
  • Partner with Product Management to create tiered "Good-Better-Best" pricing structures. 
  • Measure bundle performance and continuously optimize package economics. 

Willingness-to-Pay & Customer Research 

  • Lead willingness-to-pay studies and pricing research programs. 
  • Develop segmentation models based on customer value perception and purchasing behavior. 
  • Conduct customer interviews, surveys, conjoint analysis, Van Westendorp studies, and other pricing methodologies. 
  • Identify pricing drivers by industry, customer size, region, and product category. 
  • Translate customer insights into actionable pricing recommendations. 

Market & Competitive Intelligence 

  • Build and maintain a competitive pricing intelligence program. 
  • Monitor competitor pricing structures, packaging strategies, discounting practices, and market trends. 
  • Conduct benchmarking analyses to evaluate pricing position versus competitors. 
  • Identify emerging monetization strategies and disruptive pricing models. 
  • Provide executive recommendations on pricing actions required to maintain market competitiveness. 

Pricing Analytics & Optimization 

  • Develop pricing elasticity models and price-volume curves. 
  • Establish analytical frameworks to measure profitability, margin performance, and pricing effectiveness. 
  • Evaluate revenue impact of pricing changes before deployment. 
  • Track pricing KPIs and identify opportunities for revenue optimization. 
  • Support AI-driven and data-driven pricing initiatives. 

Cross-Functional Leadership 

  • Partner closely with Product, Finance, Commercial, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Data teams. 
  • Influence product roadmap decisions through monetization insights. 
  • Support executive leadership on strategic pricing investments and initiatives. 
  • Lead pricing councils, governance forums, and strategic pricing reviews. 
  • Manage and develop a high-performing pricing team. 

Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of experience in Pricing, Strategy, Product Management, Revenue Management, Consulting, or Commercial Excellence. 
  • 4+ years leading pricing strategy or monetization initiatives. 
  • Demonstrated experience building pricing frameworks and governance models. 
  • Strong background in market research and willingness-to-pay methodologies. 
  • Experience designing pricing bundles, packaging strategies, and commercial offers. 
  • Experience driving pricing transformations in complex organizations. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Payments, fintech, SaaS, software, technology, telecommunications, financial services, or marketplace experience. 
  • Experience with CPQ platforms, pricing systems, and revenue management tools. 
  • Knowledge of advanced pricing analytics, AI-driven pricing, and revenue optimization. 

Benefits

Denn wir können hier schreiben was wir wollen, im Endeffekt bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang in der Praxis gearbeitet und Hands-on-Erfahrungen gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Bei uns zählt vor allem, was du in der Praxis wirklich draufhast — deine mehrjährige, einschlägige Erfahrung. Formale Abschlüsse und Zertifikate sind zweitrangig, wenn dein Können überzeugt.

Wir bieten Dir

Wir wissen, dass guter Content mehr ist als nur ein Trend. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns nicht nur kreativen Freiraum, sondern auch Flexibilität, Wertschätzung und ein Team, das zusammenhält.

  • Du bekommst ein eigenes Content-Budget und die Freiheit, neue Formate zu testen, ohne unnötige Hierarchieschleifen.
  • State-of-the-Art Equipment
    Wir stellen dir professionelle Kameras, Mikrofone, Licht und ein leistungsstarkes Notebook mit zwei Monitoren für deine Postproduktion.
  • Flexibles und hybrides Arbeiten
    Wir setzen auf Vertrauensarbeitszeit ohne starre Kernzeiten, damit du deinen Tag so gestalten kannst, wie es zu deinem Rhythmus passt.
  • Wir leben eine "Test-and-Learn"-Kultur: Du darfst Risiken eingehen, testen und Content kreieren, der polarisiert – solange er unsere Mission voranbringt.
  • High-End Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook Pro M3 oder Dell XPS mit Linux. Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, inkl. 4K-Monitoren.
  • Große Reichweite
    Über die Jahre konnten wir mit unserer Plattform bereits viele Menschen erreichen. Diese große Menge an Traffic ermöglicht es uns, schnell Ergebnisse zu sehen und führt zu einem sinnesstiftenden Arbeitsgefühl.
  • Kleine Teams statt Großraumbüro
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt und schnell ins Gespräch kommt.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und keinen anderen stört), kannst du auch gerne Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen in den Räumen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch. Einen Einblick in unsere Räumlichkeiten kannst du dir auf unserer Website anschauen.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit moderner Ausstattung
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, ein leistungsstarker Laptop und eine ruhige Umgebung.
  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Gleichzeitig ist Home Office jederzeit möglich. Auch spontan und ohne lange Abstimmung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit ohne Kernzeiten
    Bei uns gibt es keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster, in denen du anwesend sein musst.
  • Flexible Teilzeitmodelle
    Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell. Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Spontan Urlaub nehmen
    Manchmal braucht man einfach eine Auszeit. Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen.
  • Familienfreundliche Kultur
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend oder kurzfristiger Arzttermin – wir wissen, dass solche Situationen zum Alltag gehören. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Kurze Wege
    Bei uns musst du dich nicht durch die Hierarchien hangeln oder lange Mails schreiben, um gehört zu werden. Du kannst jederzeit direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung sprechen. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Austausch ist direkt und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Mitgestalten statt nur abarbeiten
    Wir suchen Kolleg:innen, die mitdenken. Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie ein Prozess besser laufen kann, ein Tool sinnvoll wäre oder ein Workflow smarter funktionieren könnte, dann wirst du gehört.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Tätigkeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit – es ist Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung und spürbarer Wirkung.
  • Feel-Good-Angebote im Haus
    Unsere Feel-Good-Managerin sorgt regelmäßig für kleine Auszeiten – von Nacken- und Schultermassagen über kurze Entspannungs- und Beauty-Sessions bis hin zu Momenten zum Durchatmen.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events
    Wir feiern gern. Sommerfest am See, gemütliche Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner mit der Abteilung. Unsere Events sorgen dafür, dass wir als Team zusammenwachsen und den Arbeitsalltag auch mal beiseiteschieben können. Aber keine Sorge: Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht und eher Gehen auch kein Problem.
  • Fitnessraum im Haus
    Unser eigener Fitnessraum steht dir direkt im Haus zur Verfügung – kostenlos, gut ausgestattet und jederzeit zugänglich.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Content Creator:in bist du nicht nur für den Schnitt verantwortlich. Du kannst Strateg:in, Regisseur:in oder Performance-Analyst:in sein.

  • Strategisches Video-Scripting
    Entwicklung, Erstellung und Finalisierung kreativer Video-Konzepte und -Skripte für alle relevanten Social-Media-Kanäle (TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts).
  • Produktionsmanagement
    Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Videodrehs – von der Idee bis zum Upload.
  • Performance-Analyse
    Kontinuierliche Analyse der Content-Performance (Views, Watch Time, Engagement) und stetige Optimierung des Contents.
  • Trend-Scouting
    Identifizierung aktueller Social-Media-Trends, Formate und deren schnelle Adaption für Migrando.
  • Community- & Engagement-Management
    Aufbau und Pflege einer engagierten Community durch aktives Beantworten von Kommentaren und DMs.
  • Storytelling mit Impact
    Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Anwaltsteam, um komplexe juristische Themen in leicht verdauliche, authentische und emotionale Geschichten zu verwandeln.
  • Content-Multiplikation
    Planung der Cross-Promotion und Wiederverwertung von Content über verschiedene Plattformen hinweg.
  • Redaktionsplanung
    Erstellung einer Content-Pipeline und Redaktionsplanung für einen konstanten Output.
  • A/B-Testing
    Systematisches Testen von Thumbnails, Teasern, Titeln und Call-to-Actions, um die Klickrate und Performance zu maximieren.

Dein Profil

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang in der Praxis gearbeitet und Hands-on-Erfahrungen gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Bei uns zählt vor allem, was du in der Praxis ​draufhast - deine mehrjährige Erfahrung und ​dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

  • Video-Schnitt-Expertise
    Bestenfalls beherrschst du professionelle Video-Schnittprogramme (z.B. Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve). In unserem Social-Media-Team ist auch Bedarf an Scripting, Ideen-Entwicklung und Content-Planung, ganz ohne, dass du in die Schnittsoftware musst.
  • Social-Media-Algorithmen
    Du hast ein Verständnis für die Mechanismen, Algorithmen und Best Practices von TikTok, Instagram und YouTube.
  • Engagement-Fokus
    Du denkst nicht nur in Reichweite, sondern in Interaktion. Deine Metrik ist die Engagement Rate.
  • Scripting-Können
    Du hast Erfahrung im Storytelling und Scripting von Kurzvideos mit fesselnden Hooks und CTAs die wirken.
  • Kommunikationsstärke
    Du bist offen und hast keine Scheu, selbst vor der Kamera zu stehen oder Kolleg:innen zu motivieren, ihre Geschichte zu teilen.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität
    Du bist ein Macher-Typ, der schnell Prototypen erstellt und den Output über Perfektion stellt.
  • Lernbereitschaft
    Du bleibst am Puls der Zeit und findest aktuellen virale Trends und Formate, welche wir für unseren Content adaptieren können.
  • Was dir helfen wird
    Du kennst die Probleme und Interessen von Ausländern in Deutschland bzw. weißt, wie du so recherchieren kannst, um daraus Content zu entwickeln.
  • Keine formellen Voraussetzungen
    Du musst kein Studium oder 30 Weiterbildungen haben. Wir wollen Talente und fähige neue Kollegen finden. Selbst wenn du nicht alle Punkte hier erfüllst - wir sind auf der Suche nach erfahrenen und verantwortungsbewussten Kollegen, idealerweise bist du schon viele Jahre in dem Bereich aktiv und konntest viele Learnings mitnehmen. Denn genau daran sind wir interessiert: saubere, langfristig robuste Problemlösungen. Und die hat man meist erst, nachdem man es einige Zeit auf die harte Tour lernen musste.
  • Einfache Kommunikation
    Du bist kommunikativ und offen. Eigentlich wollen wir hier keine generischen Sachen schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist wichtig. Gute Zusammenarbeit schlägt oft reines Know-how. Ein Kollege, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos ist, kann im Alltag wertvoller sein als jemand mit mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber eher schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch oder am besten beides (ca. B2-Level). Keine Sorge, wir erwarten keinen Nachweis des Sprachniveaus.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director
Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Wiesbaden, Germany) - Relocation Provided
jobs.description:
Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Wiesbaden, Germany) - Relocation Provided

Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

About the Role

We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer to support Onebrief deployments across on-premises hardware, virtualized systems, and cloud environments.

This is a hands-on infrastructure role focused on Linux administration, hardware maintenance, and application reliability. You will manage Linux servers, NVIDIA DGX Spark or similar AI computing systems, rack-mounted equipment, and the applications running on them. You will also support workloads deployed on virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.

Your primary responsibility is keeping these environments operational and maintaining a 99.5% application availability target. You will troubleshoot production issues, perform routine maintenance, and work with engineering teams to improve system reliability.

You will work primarily on-site with military customers in Wiesbaden, Germany, alongside Onebrief Outcome Engineers, Mission Success, GRC, and Infrastructure teams. Some environments have limited connectivity or operate on air-gapped networks, requiring practical troubleshooting skills and careful planning for maintenance and deployments.

Security Clearance, Location, and Onsite Requirements

This role requires regular on-site work at customer locations in and around Wiesbaden, Germany. Relocation assistance is available.

An active Top Secret clearance is required, with the ability to obtain SCI eligibility. Active Security+ (or another DoD 8570.01-approved credential) is required, or the ability to obtain one within 30 days of hire.

About You

You have a strong background in Linux systems administration and experience supporting production applications. You are comfortable working directly with server hardware, troubleshooting operating system issues, and diagnosing application failures. You understand how infrastructure problems affect the software running on it and know how to narrow down the cause of an outage.

You take responsibility for the systems you maintain and communicate clearly when problems arise. You can work independently at a customer site while collaborating with remote engineering teams. You value good documentation, practical automation, and fixing recurring problems.

What You'll Do

  • Maintain Linux systems and hardware: Install, configure, patch, and troubleshoot Linux servers, NVIDIA DGX Spark or similar GPU systems, rack-mounted equipment, and virtual machines. Handle hardware diagnostics, firmware updates, and routine maintenance.

  • Operate production applications: Deploy, monitor, upgrade, and troubleshoot applications running on Linux, virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. Work with software engineers to resolve application issues and improve deployment processes.

  • Maintain application availability: Work toward a 99.5% uptime target across assigned environments. Monitor application and system health, respond to alerts, investigate performance issues, and address problems before they cause extended outages.

  • Respond to incidents: Diagnose hardware, operating system, network, and application failures. Restore service, coordinate escalations, and document root causes and corrective actions through After Action Reviews (AARs).

  • Improve operations through automation: Use scripting and configuration management tools to simplify deployments, patching, monitoring, and recovery. Support secure operations in cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped environments.

What We Look For

  • Active Top Secret clearance, with the ability to obtain SCI eligibility.

  • 5+ years of experience in Linux systems administration, SRE, infrastructure engineering, or a related role.

  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including networking, storage, system performance, and security configuration.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining physical servers and troubleshooting hardware failures.

  • Experience supporting production applications on Linux servers, virtual machines, or containers.

jobs.title: Senior stedenbouwkundige
jobs.description:
Senior stedenbouwkundige

Jouw impact bij Movares

Waar complexiteit samenkomt, breng jij helderheid en richting.  

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Jij bent het boegbeeld van onze visie op stedelijke knooppunten en woningbouw. Ruimtelijke ontwikkeling binnen de stedelijke context zijn voor jou bekend gebied. Je vertegenwoordigt Movares extern waarbij je ons netwerk én gedachtengoed versterkt; 

  • Met jouw duidelijke visie stuur je multidisciplinaire teams en complexe gebiedsontwikkelingen aan, waarbij je innovatie en (technische) kennis inzet om ruimtelijke kwaliteit te vergroten; 

  • Je denkt vroeg in processen mee over vernieuwende oplossingen voor de leefomgeving en draagt jouw expertise actief over aan jongere collega’s.

Bij Movares werken we aan de stad van morgen. Aan plekken waar verdichting, mobiliteit en leefkwaliteit samenkomen. We zoeken een senior stedenbouwkundige die daar richting aan geeft: inhoudelijk sterk, ontwerpgedreven en met plezier midden in het vak. 

Als senior stedenbouwkundige bij Movares ben je een inhoudelijk trekker binnen complexe gebiedsontwikkelingen. Je werkt aan stedelijke verdichting, woningbouw en knooppunten en vertaalt maatschappelijke opgaven naar scherpe analyses, ruimtelijke concepten en overtuigende ontwerpen. Met jouw visie breng je samenhang tussen schaalniveaus, disciplines en belangen, en zorg je dat ruimtelijke kwaliteit steeds het uitgangspunt blijft. Je zit vroeg aan tafel, denkt mee over koers en strategie en ontwikkelt vernieuwende oplossingen voor de leefomgeving. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams waarin ontwerp, mobiliteit, planologie en techniek elkaar versterken. Daarbij ben je een natuurlijke sparringpartner voor collega’s: je deelt kennis, scherpt ideeën aan en begeleidt jongere stedenbouwkundigen in hun ontwikkeling. Met jouw ervaring en netwerk draag je actief bij aan de zichtbaarheid en inhoudelijke positionering van Movares in het werkveld. 

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Jij bent een initiatiefrijke en enthousiaste stedenbouwkundige met een duidelijke visie, iemand die de wereld elke dag een beetje mooier maakt. Je neemt mensen vanzelfsprekend mee in jouw visie, blijft nieuwsgierig, communiceert glashelder en weet collega’s te inspireren, te coachen en te motiveren om samen het hoogst haalbare te bereiken. Daarnaast bouw je sterke klantrelaties en ben je een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt.

Dit breng je ook mee: 

  • een afgeronde WO-opleiding Urban Design / Stedenbouw (TU of Academie voor Bouwkunst), en minimaal 10 jaar relevante werkervaring; 

  • belangstelling voor maatschappelijke opgaven zoals duurzame mobiliteit, klimaatadaptatie en energietransitie; 

  • ervaring met programma’s zoals Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, GIS en Sketchup is een pré; 

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan mooie projecten met maatschappelijke impact. Dat geeft energie en voldoening, iets wat niet in geld is uit te drukken.

Je draagt bij aan het verschil dat we samen maken voor de openbare ruimte in Nederland door te blijven groeien in je vak én als professional. Daarom krijg je in elke fase van jouw loopbaan de ruimte om jouw ontwikkeling actief vorm te geven, ondersteund door learning on the job, masterclasses en een brede leeromgeving in onze eigen Academy.


Dat is niet alles. We bieden ook goede primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Die zetten we hieronder voor je op een rij:

  •          een salaris tussen €5.500,- en €8.000,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur;

  •          de intentie om duurzaam met elkaar samen te werken, met perspectief op een vast dienstverband;

  •          een aantrekkelijk pakket van secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden inclusief fiscaal voordelige regelingen;

  •          duurzaam reizen voor je werk met een goede mobiliteitsregeling;

  •          goede faciliteiten om je werk te kunnen doen thuis of op kantoor;

  •          een moderne pensioenregeling met aandacht voor jouw toekomst;

  •          oog voor jouw persoonlijke situatie, met maatwerk in werkplek of begeleiding als dat nodig is.

​En er is méér. Want werken bij Movares betekent ook: 

  •          vertrouwen en flexibiliteit in hoe en waar je werkt, passend bij jouw team en werkzaamheden;

  •          werk dat ertoe doet: je draagt bij aan een duurzamere en schonere leefomgeving, samen met collega’s die dit belangrijk vinden;

  •          aandacht voor verbinding en plezier tijdens activiteiten met collega’s, inhoudelijk én informeel.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je versterkt het team Landschap en Stedenbouw, waar je samenwerkt met architecten en andere creatieve ruimtelijke denkers. Met meer dan 50 collega's bundelen jullie ontwerpkracht, visie en vakmanschap binnen de Movares organisatie. Dat team is volop in ontwikkeling. Daarom zoeken we senioriteit die kennis en ervaring combineert met nieuwe inzichten rondom gebiedsontwikkeling en stedelijke knooppunten.

Je werkt aan projecten die de kwaliteit van de leefomgeving verbeteren. We combineren creativiteit met technische kennis om integrale oplossingen te ontwerpen voor stedelijke en landschappelijke vraagstukken. Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinair team van ontwerpers en adviseurs, waarin intensief wordt samengewerkt met specialisten op het gebied van onder andere planologie, mobiliteit, ecologie en techniek. We zijn een hecht team waarin samenwerken en elkaar helpen vanzelfsprekend is. Kortom, je komt in een omgeving waar vakinhoudelijke uitdaging en een fijne werksfeer hand in hand gaan. Samen zorgen we voor een toekomstbestendige en inspirerende leefomgeving. 

 Samen geven we vorm aan een toekomstbestendige leefomgeving. Doe je mee?

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, Zephr
jobs.description:
Technical Account Manager, Zephr

Role : Technical Account Manager, Zephr

Location, Sofia, Bulgaria / Italy - Bari or Naples

Company Overview

At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We help companies subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies, and ultimately the planet. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, including Zuora Billing, Revenue, Collect, and Zephr, we help the world's most innovative companies monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships, and optimize digital experiences.

Zephr, Zuora's subscription experience platform, helps digital businesses create, personalize, and monetize subscriber journeys across websites, apps, identity flows, paywalls, and connected commerce experiences.

The Team & Role

We are looking for a Technical Account Manager, Zephr to join our Technical Account Management team.

As a Senior Zephr TAM, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers using Zephr to power digital subscription, registration, identity, entitlement, and paywall experiences. You will provide ongoing architecture guidance, best-practice recommendations, technical design reviews, and proactive advisory support to help customers increase value from their Zephr investment.

This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can combine deep Zephr product expertise, strong web technology knowledge, and commercial awareness. You will work with customer product, marketing, engineering, architecture, and operations teams to understand business objectives, assess technical design choices, identify risks, and recommend scalable paths forward.

You will also partner closely with Zuora Customer Success, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to ensure customers receive coordinated guidance and clear next steps.

This is a Sofia-based role with flexible work arrangements. The role requires availability across EMEA business hours and regular overlap with US-based stakeholders, customers, and internal teams.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor for Zephr customers, helping them optimize their implementation and align Zephr capabilities to business goals.
  • Lead regular customer office hours, technical reviews, design discussions, roadmap alignment sessions, and executive-friendly technical readouts.
  • Advise customers on Zephr architecture, configuration, identity flows, access rules, paywalls, registration journeys, personalization, and integrations.
  • Review customer designs and implementation approaches to identify scalability, maintainability, performance, or operational risks.
  • Guide customers on adoption of new Zephr and Billing capabilities that improve digital subscription growth, operational efficiency, and subscriber experience.
  • Maintain or guide the creation of architecture documentation, implementation notes, runbooks, and technical decision records.
  • Support troubleshooting of complex customer issues involving Zephr configuration, integrations, browser behavior, APIs, webhooks, and data flows.
  • Partner with Support and Product teams to provide customer context, escalate issues appropriately, and advocate for product improvements.
  • Translate customer business priorities into practical technical recommendations and phased action plans.
  • Mentor and support internal teams by sharing Zephr best practices, reusable guidance, and customer implementation patterns.

Your experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, Technical Consulting, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Hands-on experience with Zephr preferred, including customer implementations, configuration, integrations, or ongoing technical advisory.
  • Strong experience working with enterprise SaaS customers, ideally in digital subscriptions, media, publishing, e-commerce, identity, martech, or customer engagement platforms.
  • Solid understanding of modern web technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and browser-based application behavior.
  • Familiarity with technologies commonly used in Zephr ecosystems, such as CMS platforms, CDNs, CDPs, identity providers, React, GraphQL, and tag management tools.
  • Ability to analyze customer requirements, separate critical needs from nice-to-haves, and recommend practical technical designs.
  • Experience facilitating technical workshops, design reviews, customer training, and senior stakeholder readouts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple strategic customers and priorities while maintaining clear ownership, follow-through, and documentation.
  • Experience working across EMEA and US time zones.
  • Experience with Zuora Billing, subscription monetization, entitlement management, or quote-to-cash processes is a plus.
  • Media, publishing, or digital subscription industry experience is a strong plus.

What success looks like

  • Customers view you as a trusted senior advisor for Zephr architecture, adoption, and optimization.
  • Customer teams have clearer architecture, stronger documentation, and fewer avoidable implementation risks.
  • Customers adopt relevant Zephr and Zuora capabilities with confidence.
  • Complex customer issues are better contextualized, prioritized, and coordinated across Zuora teams.
  • Product and Support teams receive actionable customer feedback grounded in real implementation needs.
  • Zephr customers see stronger value realization from their ongoing partnership with Zuora.

#ZEOLife at Zuora

As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways. Our people, whom we call ZEOs, are empowered to take ownership and make a bigger impact. We collaborate deeply, exchange ideas openly, and together we make what's next possible for our customers, community, and the world.

jobs.title: Scientific Engagement
jobs.description:
Scientific Engagement

About Ataraxis AI

Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients.

Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi-modal clinical data. This spans our causality (Ataraxis™ Tau), foundation model (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and survival analysis research.

Our first clinical products, such as Ataraxis™ Breast for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide.

At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine.

Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity).

We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential.

About this role

This role is ideal for early-career candidates with scientific background, or candidates looking to transition to industry, who are competitive and interested in building the company through the commercial-scientific lens. You'll run high-volume, high-quality scientific outreach to top physicians in the country. Your job is to first have a scientific conversation, run it credibly at a peer level, and convert it into business objectives: a first order, an early access enrollment, or a qualified handoff to our sales team. This is a rare opportunity that can grow into more scientific or more commercial roles long-term, and can provide significant upside, but will require people with more scientific background to handle commercial/sales-like conversations and focus on commercial outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Own outbound scientific engagement to high-priority oncologists and surgeons: personalized email, calls, video meetings, conference follow-up.

  • Present our validation data, methodology, and clinical utility evidence fluently and handle hard questions on study design, comparators, and guidelines.

  • Convert interest into first orders or early access participation; pass larger accounts to field sales with full context.

  • Feed physician objections and evidence gaps back to our clinical and product teams.

  • Support field reps as the on-call scientific closer for their toughest accounts.

Qualifications

  • PhD (or MD/PharmD) in a relevant field, ideally related to cancer biology.

  • Genuine command of clinical oncology literature; ability to read and critique trial design.

  • Persuasive writer and speaker: You enjoy convincing smart, skeptical people. You can present in a scientifically charming way.

  • We realize that your background might be science/research-heavy. This role is going to be the best for people who are competitive, can work in a metric-driven/outcome-driven environment, can work with quotas and maintaining commercial pipeline.

  • High proficiency in Google Slides/PowerPoint; able to craft compelling, clean, data-driven visuals.

Full-Time USA

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Platform Engineer

About Augur

Augur transforms legacy sensor systems into real-time operational intelligence. We help organisations act before threats escalate – not after damage is done. Everything we build is privacy-first by design.

Our platform connects to existing cameras and sensors to detect threats, retrace events, and surface real-time insights – all without replacing a single device. Augur helps teams reduce risk, cut costs, and grow revenue through better visibility, faster decisions, and fewer blind spots.

Our culture is built on a foundation of radical candor and mutual trust. We recognise that being an industry leader requires more than just building exceptional products – it requires empowering a team of exceptional people. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence.

The Role

As a Platform Engineer at Augur, you will be responsible for the availability, performance, and scalability of our critical systems. You will bridge the gap between software development and IT operations by applying a software engineering mindset to system administration.

● System Architecture and Design: Design, build, and maintain the core infrastructure that runs our platforms. Develop scalable, secure and highly reliable systems to support our services.
● Automation and Tooling: Automate manual operational tasks, including deployment, monitoring, and incident response. Develop and maintain tools to improve efficiency and reduce the potential for human error.
● Software Development: Write and review code (Ansible, Terraform, Python) for infrastructure automation, monitoring tools, and system improvements. Contribute to the development lifecycle to ensure reliability is built into our products from the start.
● Performance and Reliability: Proactively monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to ensure high availability and low latency. Fill in the gaps in monitoring systems when observed.
● Incident Management: Participate in an on-call rotation to respond to production incidents. Lead incident response, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventative measures to avoid future occurrences.
● Capacity Planning: Analyse system usage, cost and performance data to make informed decisions about resource allocation. Forecast future infrastructure needs and scale our systems accordingly.
● Collaboration and Best Practices: Work closely with software development teams to promote reliability best practices. Champion a culture of reliability across the engineering organisation.
● Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date documentation for all systems, processes, and operational procedures as a core part of everyday work. Treat documentation as a first-class engineering deliverable.

Accessibility and inclusivity

At Augur, our culture is built on radical candor and mutual trust. To solve the complex, physical-world problems our customers face, we need a team that thinks differently.

Whether you’re self-taught, have a non-traditional background, or are returning to the workforce, if you have the grit and the experience we’re looking for at Augur, we’d love to hear from you.

We are committed to fostering a diverse workplace and ensuring an accessible hiring experience - please let us know if you require any accommodations during the interview process to help you do your best work.
